topic.zh: 传输线基础 · 衰减

statement.zh:
你想把电视连接到位于房屋另一侧的有线电视信号接入点。你手头唯一可用于此目的的同轴电缆（T1）具有以下性质：
• 长度：$30\,\mathrm{m}$
• 特性阻抗：$75\,\Omega$
• 速度因子：$0.85$

有线电视接入点由电压源 $V_g$ 构成，其幅值为 $1\,\mathrm{V}$，源阻抗 $R_g$ 为 $75\,\Omega$，频率 $f$ 为 $250\,\mathrm{MHz}$。电视的负载阻抗 $R_L$ 也是 $75\,\Omega$。下图给出了这一连接的电路图。
statement.en:
You want to connect your television to a cable TV feed point located on the opposite side of your house. The only coaxial cable (T1) you have available for this purpose has the following properties:
• Length: $30\,\mathrm{m}$
• Characteristic impedance: $75\,\Omega$
• Velocity factor: $0.85$

The cable TV feed point consists of a voltage source $V_g$ with an amplitude of $1\,\mathrm{V}$, source impedance $R_g$ of $75\,\Omega$ and frequency $f$ of $250\,\mathrm{MHz}$. The television’s load impedance $R_L$ is also $75\,\Omega$. A circuit diagram illustrating this setup is shown below.

figureCaption.zh: 复刻原卷插图，保留原图的视角、结构与标注。
figureCaption.en: Recreated from the exam figure, preserving its perspective, geometry and labels.

prompt.zh: 如果用所给电缆将有线电视接入点连接到电视，负载处是否会发生反射？解释原因。
prompt.en: If you use the provided cable to connect the cable TV feed point to your television, will there be a reflection at the load? Explain why or why not.

text.zh: 先写原表的负载反射系数，比较的是负载阻抗和线的特性阻抗。
text.en: Begin with the crib load reflection coefficient, comparing load impedance with line characteristic impedance.

text.zh: 本题电视负载与电缆均为 75 Ω，逐项代入分子和分母。
text.en: Both the television load and cable are 75 Ω. Substitute them into numerator and denominator.

text.zh: 反射电压幅度等于入射幅度乘 ΓL，因此不存在由负载产生的反向波。
text.en: The reflected voltage amplitude is the incident amplitude times ΓL, so the load produces no backward wave.

text.zh: 结论是负载匹配、无反射；源阻抗相同也避免源端失配。
text.en: The load is matched with no reflection; the equal source impedance also avoids source mismatch.

prompt.zh: 这根同轴电缆的时间延迟是多少？
prompt.en: What is the time delay of the coaxial cable?

text.zh: 先写波速和传播时间的关系，速度因子是相对真空光速的比值。
text.en: Begin with the wave-speed and propagation-time relations; velocity factor is relative to vacuum light speed.

text.zh: 将 0.85 和 3×10⁸ m/s 代入，先得到电缆内的实际传播速度。
text.en: Substitute 0.85 and 3×10⁸ m/s to obtain the cable propagation speed first.

text.zh: 长度除以波速，米约去后结果为秒。
text.en: Divide length by speed; meters cancel, leaving seconds.

text.zh: 利用 1 ns=10⁻⁹ s 转换单位；这是单程时间，不再乘 2。
text.en: Convert using 1 ns=10⁻⁹ s. This is one-way time, so do not multiply by two.

prompt.zh: 信号在这根同轴电缆上的波长是多少
prompt.en: What is the wavelength of the signal on the coaxial cable

text.zh: 先写原表的波长关系，使用电缆内部波速。
text.en: Begin with the crib wavelength relation, using the cable wave speed.

text.zh: 把频率由 MHz 换成 Hz，并写出上问得到的波速。
text.en: Convert MHz to Hz and state the previously determined speed.

text.zh: 将数值及单位代入波长公式。
text.en: Substitute numerical values and units into the wavelength equation.

text.zh: 化简得到电缆内波长，而非真空中的 1.20 m。
text.en: Simplify to the cable wavelength, rather than the vacuum wavelength of 1.20 m.

prompt.zh: 假设可将电缆视为低损耗线，且单位长度电阻为 $r=1\,\Omega/\mathrm{m}$，计算负载处入射电压波的幅值。
prompt.en: Assuming that the cable can be considered low-loss and has a per-length resistance of $r=1\,\Omega/\mathrm{m}$, calculate the amplitude of the incident voltage wave at the load.

text.zh: 先写原表的低损耗衰减式与行波包络；本题使用可忽略并联漏电导的模型。
text.en: Begin with the crib low-loss attenuation and traveling-wave envelope, using the model with negligible shunt conductance.

text.zh: 代入每单位长度电阻和特性阻抗，求出 α。
text.en: Substitute resistance per length and characteristic impedance to calculate α.

text.zh: 负载入射波的起始幅度不是源电压 1 V，必须先做源端分压。
text.en: The launched amplitude is not the 1 V source voltage; apply the source divider first.

text.zh: 传播到 30 m，衰减指数 αL 是无量纲的 0.2。
text.en: At 30 m, the attenuation exponent αL is dimensionless and equals 0.2.

text.zh: 求指数值得到负载处的入射电压幅度；ΓL=0，所以没有额外反射项。
text.en: Evaluate the exponential to obtain the incident load amplitude. Since ΓL=0, there is no additional reflected term.

prompt.zh: 如果同轴电缆的特性阻抗改为 $50\Omega$，为保证从源到负载的最大功率传输，所需电缆的最小长度 $(L>0)$ 是多少？
prompt.en: If the coaxial cable’s characteristic impedance were instead $50\Omega$, what is the minimum length of cable $(L>0)$ needed to be to ensure maximum power transfer from the source to the load?

text.zh: 最大功率传输要求源看到的输入阻抗与 75 Ω 源电阻匹配；按原题采用无损匹配近似。
text.en: Maximum power transfer requires the input seen by the source to match its 75 Ω resistance. Use the source’s lossless matching approximation.

text.zh: 原表的半波线性质会将负载原样重复到输入端，不论中间电缆是否为 50 Ω。
text.en: The crib half-wave property repeats the load at the input even with a 50 Ω cable in between.

text.zh: 核对最短正长度：代入通用输入阻抗并令 Zin=ZL，因 Z₀≠ZL，只能使 tan(βL)=0。
text.en: Check the shortest positive length: setting Zin=ZL in the general equation with Z₀≠ZL requires tan(βL)=0.

text.zh: 沿用同一速度因子与频率，波长仍为 1.02 m，n 取最小正整数 1。
text.en: The unchanged velocity factor and frequency give λ=1.02 m. Choose the smallest positive integer n=1.

text.zh: 这是重复阻抗的半波长度，不是把 75 Ω 变换成另一电阻的四分之一波长。
text.en: This is the half-wave impedance-repeat length.

concept.zh: 本题把传输线匹配、传播速度和低损耗衰减放在同一条有线电视连接中考查。
concept.en: This problem connects impedance matching, propagation speed and low-loss attenuation in a cable-TV link.

known.zh: 电缆长 $30\,\mathrm m$，速度因子为 $0.85$，频率为 $250\,\mathrm{MHz}$；初始情况下源、线和负载均为 $75\,\Omega$。衰减小问另给出单位长度电阻。
known.en: The cable is $30\,\mathrm m$ long, with velocity factor $0.85$ and frequency $250\,\mathrm{MHz}$. Initially the source, line and load are all $75\,\Omega$; the attenuation part also supplies the resistance per unit length.

goal.zh: 判断反射，求延迟、波长和到达负载的入射电压，再研究换用另一种电缆后的最短匹配长度。
goal.en: Check reflection, find delay, wavelength and the incident voltage at the load, then find the shortest matching length for a different cable.

approach.zh: 先比较负载与特性阻抗，再把速度因子换成波速。求电压幅值时分别考虑源端分压和沿线衰减；最后利用输入阻抗随电长度重复的性质。
approach.en: Start by comparing load and line impedances, then convert velocity factor to speed. Separate the launch voltage divider from propagation loss, and use the periodicity of input impedance for the final part.

title.zh: 传输线与超导量子比特

topic.zh: 反弹图 · 有限脉冲

statement.zh:
在超导量子计算机中，沿传输线发送（微波）电压脉冲来对量子比特进行操作。考虑一根具有以下参数的传输线：
• 单位长度电感：$l=400\,\mathrm{nH/m}$
• 单位长度电容：$c=160\,\mathrm{pF/m}$
• 传输时间（延迟）：$T_d=10\,\mathrm{ns}$
在 $t=0$ 时，电压源沿传输线向负载发送一个幅值为 $3\,\mathrm{V}$、持续时间为 $1\,\mathrm{ns}$ 的单个直流脉冲。由于电路损坏，源阻抗和负载阻抗从原设计值增大为 $R_g=100\,\Omega$ 和 $R_L=200\,\Omega$，如下方电路图所示。
statement.en:
In superconducting quantum computers, (microwave) voltage pulses are sent down transmission lines to perform operations on qubits. Consider one such transmission line with the following parameters:
• Per-length inductance: $l=400\,\mathrm{nH/m}$
• Per-length capacitance: $c=160\,\mathrm{pF/m}$
• Transit time (delay): $T_d=10\,\mathrm{ns}$
At time $t=0$, the voltage source sends a single DC pulse with amplitude $3\,\mathrm{V}$ and duration $1\,\mathrm{ns}$ down the transmission line toward the load. Due to damage to the circuit, the values of the source impedance and load impedance have increased from their originally designed values to $R_g=100\,\Omega$ and $R_L=200\,\Omega$, as shown in the circuit schematic below.

figureCaption.zh: 复刻原卷插图，保留原图的视角、结构与标注。
figureCaption.en: Recreated from the exam figure, preserving its perspective, geometry and labels.

prompt.zh: 计算传输线的特性阻抗。
prompt.en: Calculate the characteristic impedance of the transmission line.

text.zh: 先写无损传输线特性阻抗原式。l、c 都是每单位长度参数。
text.en: Begin with the lossless characteristic-impedance equation; l and c are both per-length parameters.

text.zh: 先把 nH 与 pF 换成 H 与 F，两个前缀不能直接相消。
text.en: Convert nH and pF to H and F before forming their ratio.

text.zh: 计算根号内的比值，单位为 Ω²。
text.en: Evaluate the ratio under the square root, in Ω².

text.zh: 取正平方根，因为这里特性阻抗为正实数。
text.en: Take the positive square root for this positive real characteristic impedance.

prompt.zh: 进入传输线的初始电压脉冲 $V_1^+$ 的幅值是多少？
prompt.en: What is the initial amplitude of the voltage pulse $V_1^+$ that makes it into the transmission line?

text.zh: 原始分压公式给出尚未收到负载反射时进入线路的第一行波。
text.en: The launch-divider equation gives the first traveling wave before any load reflection returns.

text.zh: 本题源脉冲为 3 V，损坏后的源电阻为 100 Ω，线路仍为 50 Ω。
text.en: The source pulse is 3 V, the damaged source resistance is 100 Ω and the line remains 50 Ω.

text.zh: 先求分压比 50/150=1/3，再乘源幅度；脉冲宽度仍是 1 ns。
text.en: Evaluate 50/150=1/3 and multiply by source amplitude; pulse width remains 1 ns.

text.zh: 因此最初入射到线路的电压是 1 V，而非整个源脉冲的 3 V。
text.en: The initially launched voltage is therefore 1 V.

parts.label: c

prompt.zh: 画出 $0\le t<4T$ 内脉冲电压幅值的反弹图。必须标注行波电压幅值，以及在负载和源端测得的幅值。不必计算 $t=4T_d$ 时源端的总电压。
prompt.en: Sketch a bounce diagram for the voltage amplitude of the pulse for time $0\le t<4T$. Be sure to label both traveling voltage amplitudes and the amplitudes that would be measured at the load and the source. You do not need to calculate the total voltage at the source for $t=4T_d$.

text.zh: 先写端点反射公式以及到达波与反射波相加得到测量电压的关系。
text.en: Begin with endpoint reflection and the relation between measured voltage, arriving wave and its immediate reflection.

text.zh: 分别把负载和源阻抗代入，得到两个正的反射系数。
text.en: Substitute the load and source resistances separately to obtain both positive reflection coefficients.

text.zh: 初始脉冲在 0 时刻从源出发，于 Tᵈ=10 ns 到达负载；负载产生第一反向波。
text.en: The initial pulse leaves the source at zero and reaches the load at Tᵈ=10 ns, producing the first backward wave.

text.zh: 逐项计算第一次负载反射及负载实际电压；此处反射系数乘的是入射的 V₁⁺。
text.en: Calculate the first load reflection and actual load voltage. The reflection coefficient multiplies incident V₁⁺.

text.zh: 20 ns 时反向波回到源，源反射生成 V₂⁺；源端测到的是 V₁⁻+V₂⁺。
text.en: At 20 ns the return reaches the source and generates V₂⁺; measured source voltage is V₁⁻+V₂⁺.

text.zh: 30 ns 时第二次正向脉冲到达负载，继续乘 ΓL，负载电压仍是到达波与反射波之和。
text.en: At 30 ns the second forward pulse reaches the load. Multiply by ΓL again and add arrival plus reflection.

text.zh: 在反弹图上按 0、10、20、30、40 ns 标时刻。所有波宽均为 1 ns，彼此不重叠，不能像永久阶跃那样累加旧脉冲。
text.en: Label the diagram at 0, 10, 20, 30 and 40 ns. All pulses last 1 ns and do not overlap, so do not accumulate old pulses as for a permanent step.

steps.math: \begin{gathered}V_1^-=0.60\,\mathrm V,\quad V_2^+=0.20\,\mathrm V,\quad V_2^-=0.12\,\mathrm V\\V_L(10\,\mathrm{ns})=1.60\,\mathrm V,\quad V_{\mathrm{in}}(20\,\mathrm{ns})=0.80\,\mathrm V,\quad V_L(30\,\mathrm{ns})=0.32\,\mathrm V\end{gathered}

parts.answer: \begin{gathered}V_1^-=0.60\,\mathrm V,\quad V_2^+=0.20\,\mathrm V,\quad V_2^-=0.12\,\mathrm V\\V_L(10\,\mathrm{ns})=1.60\,\mathrm V,\quad V_{\mathrm{in}}(20\,\mathrm{ns})=0.80\,\mathrm V,\quad V_L(30\,\mathrm{ns})=0.32\,\mathrm V\end{gathered}

figureCaption.zh: 1 ns 有限脉冲的反弹图：标出各行波及源、负载处的测量电压。
figureCaption.en: Bounce diagram for a finite 1 ns pulse, labeling traveling waves and measured source/load voltages.

prompt.zh: 经过无限多次反弹后 $(t\to\infty)$，传输线上的电压是多少？
prompt.en: What will be the voltage on the transmission line after an infinite number of bounces $(t\to\infty)$?

text.zh: 先写每一轮反弹的递推式；相继正向波相差一整次负载反射和源反射。
text.en: Begin with the bounce recurrence: successive forward waves differ by one load and one source reflection.

text.zh: 将上一问两系数相乘，得到小于 1 的往返倍率。
text.en: Multiply the preceding coefficients to obtain the round-trip factor, smaller than one.

text.zh: 题目只发出一个 1 ns 脉冲，源随后回到零；后续有限宽脉冲的幅度逐轮趋于零。
text.en: Only one 1 ns pulse is emitted, after which the source returns to zero; subsequent finite-width pulse amplitudes decay to zero.

text.zh: 因此稳态没有持续激励。端点电阻吸收脉冲能量，不能套用持续 DC 源的分压值。
text.en: There is no sustained excitation. The termination resistors absorb the pulse energy, so a permanent-DC divider value does not apply.

concept.zh: 本题考查有限宽度脉冲在失配传输线上的发射、反射与反弹图。
concept.en: This problem follows the launch and repeated reflections of a finite-duration pulse on a mismatched line.

known.zh: $l=400\,\mathrm{nH/m}$、$c=160\,\mathrm{pF/m}$、$T_d=10\,\mathrm{ns}$；源脉冲为 $3\,\mathrm V$、持续 $1\,\mathrm{ns}$，$R_g=100\,\Omega$、$R_L=200\,\Omega$。
known.en: The line has $l=400\,\mathrm{nH/m}$, $c=160\,\mathrm{pF/m}$ and $T_d=10\,\mathrm{ns}$. A $3\,\mathrm V$, $1\,\mathrm{ns}$ source pulse drives $R_g=100\,\Omega$ and $R_L=200\,\Omega$.

goal.zh: 求特性阻抗和初始入射脉冲，标清各次反射与端点测得的电压，并判断长时间后的状态。
goal.en: Find the characteristic impedance and initial pulse, label reflected waves and measured endpoint voltages, and determine the long-time behavior.

approach.zh: 先由分布参数求特性阻抗，再求源端分压与两端反射系数。反弹图中要区分行波幅值和端点总电压，并记住源脉冲会结束。
approach.en: Find line impedance from its distributed parameters, then the launch divider and both reflection coefficients. Distinguish traveling-wave amplitudes from total endpoint voltage, and remember that the source pulse ends.

topic.zh: 输入阻抗 · 电压相量

statement.zh: 下图电路中的传输线具有特性阻抗 $Z_0=50\Omega$，长度为 $L=\frac{\lambda}{4}$。正弦源电压的幅值为 $V_g=10\,\mathrm{V}$，其波长为 $\lambda=20\,\mathrm{m}$，频率为 $f=100\,\mathrm{kHz}$。
statement.en: The transmission line in the circuit below has a characteristic impedance $Z_0=50\Omega$ and length $L=\frac{\lambda}{4}$. The amplitude of the sinusoidal source voltage is $V_g=10\,\mathrm{V}$, its wavelength is $\lambda=20\,\mathrm{m}$ and its frequency is $f=100\,\mathrm{kHz}$.

figureCaption.zh: 复刻原卷插图，保留原图的视角、结构与标注。
figureCaption.en: Recreated from the exam figure, preserving its perspective, geometry and labels.

label.zh: 输入阻抗的四分之一波长性质

prompt.zh: 计算这根传输线的 $Z_{in}$。
prompt.en: Calculate $Z_{in}$ for the transmission line.

text.zh: 先写原表的四分之一波长阻抗变换性质。
text.en: Begin with the crib quarter-wave impedance transformation.

text.zh: 将本题 Z₀=50 Ω、负载 125 Ω 代入，平方的阻抗单位要保留。
text.en: Substitute Z₀=50 Ω and load 125 Ω, retaining units in the squared impedance.

text.zh: 由 λ/4 的变换性质，输入为实数；与 50 Ω 源并不匹配。
text.en: The quarter-wave property gives a real input, which does not match the 50 Ω source.

prompt.zh: 写出传输线上总电压波 $\widetilde V(z)$ 的相量。
prompt.en: Write down the phasor for the total voltage wave $\widetilde V(z)$ on the transmission line.

text.zh: 先写总行波相量原式。明确本页取输入端 z=0、负载端 z=L，源相位为零。
text.en: Begin with the total traveling-wave phasor. Set z=0 at the input, z=L at the load and zero source phase.

text.zh: 由波长求 β 与线长，再求往返传播相位。
text.en: Use the wavelength to compute β and length, then the round-trip phase.

text.zh: 先计算负载参考面的反射系数。
text.en: First calculate the reflection coefficient at the load reference plane.

text.zh: 移至输入参考面必须乘往返相位；因此输入面的反向系数是负的。
text.en: Moving to the input plane requires the round-trip phase, making the backward coefficient negative there.

text.zh: 写源端电压边界。Rg=Z₀ 时反向项抵消，只剩 2V⁺，由此确定正向幅度。
text.en: Write the source voltage boundary. Since Rg=Z₀, the backward terms cancel, leaving 2V⁺ and fixing the forward amplitude.

text.zh: 代入 Vg=10 V，并乘输入反射系数求反向幅度。
text.en: Substitute Vg=10 V and multiply by the input reflection coefficient for the backward amplitude.

text.zh: 核对输入端分压：相量之和应为 10×20/(50+20)。这也检验反向项的符号。
text.en: Check input voltage division: the coefficient sum must equal 10×20/(50+20), verifying the backward sign.

text.zh: 将 β、正向与反向系数代回总行波相量。
text.en: Substitute β and both amplitudes into the traveling-wave phasor.

note.zh: 官方解写成 5e⁻ʲᵝᶻ+2.145eʲᵝᶻ，却未声明原点。对本页明确的“输入端 z=0、源相位 0”约定，反向项必须为负，否则不满足输入分压。若以负载为原点，两项还需统一的 −j 相位。
note.en: The official solution prints 5e⁻ʲᵝᶻ+2.145eʲᵝᶻ without fixing its origin. For the input-origin, zero-source-phase convention here, the backward term must be negative to satisfy the source divider. With a load origin both coefficients also carry a common −j phase.

prompt.zh: 将 $\widetilde V(z)$ 的表达式转换为时域形式 $v(z,t)$。
prompt.en: Convert your expression for $\widetilde V(z)$ to the time domain $v(z,t)$.

text.zh: 先写相量到瞬时值的定义，采用与前问相同的 eʲωt 约定。
text.en: Begin with the phasor-to-time definition using the same eʲωt convention as above.

text.zh: 将 100 kHz 转为 Hz，再计算角频率。
text.en: Convert 100 kHz to Hz and calculate angular frequency.

text.zh: 把上一问两个行波全部代入，并把时间因子分别乘进去。
text.en: Substitute both preceding waves and distribute the time factor.

text.zh: 逐项使用 Re(eʲθ)=cosθ；第二项的负实幅度必须保留。
text.en: Apply Re(eʲθ)=cosθ term by term, retaining the negative real amplitude of the second wave.

prompt.zh: 要向负载传输最大功率，需要找到一根长度相同 $(L=\lambda/4)$、但特性阻抗不同的传输线。新传输线的特性阻抗应是多少？
prompt.en: In order to deliver maximum power to the load, you would need to find a transmission line with the same length $(L=\lambda/4)$, but with a different characteristic impedance. What would the characteristic impedance of this new transmission line need to be?

text.zh: 先写最大功率传输的实阻抗匹配条件，以及原表四分之一波长变换式。
text.en: Begin with the resistive maximum-power matching condition and the crib quarter-wave relation.

text.zh: 保持线长 λ/4，待选的是变换线的特性阻抗 Z₀T。把源和负载代入。
text.en: Keep the length λ/4 and solve for transformer characteristic impedance Z₀T. Substitute source and load values.

text.zh: 两边乘 125 Ω，再取正平方根。
text.en: Multiply by 125 Ω and take the positive square root.

text.zh: 所得特性阻抗使源看到 50 Ω 的实输入阻抗。
text.en: The resulting characteristic impedance presents a real 50 Ω input to the source.

prompt.zh: 虽然第 (d) 问所选传输线在稳态下向负载传输最大功率，但传输线负载处仍会发生反射。为什么最大功率传输与传输线上的反射可以同时存在？
prompt.en: Even though the transmission line you chose in part (d) delivers maximum power to the load in steady state, reflections will still occur on the transmission line at the load. How can there be maximum power transfer, but also reflections on the transmission line?

text.zh: 先写负载局部反射系数，再写整个网络向源呈现的输入阻抗；两者的参考位置不同。
text.en: Begin with the local load reflection coefficient and the input impedance of the whole network; they describe different reference planes.

text.zh: 将上一问选出的 Z₀T 代入输入阻抗，明确验证源端匹配。
text.en: Substitute the chosen Z₀T and explicitly verify the source input match.

text.zh: 同一个变换线在负载处仍与 125 Ω 不相等，所以局部反射系数非零。
text.en: At the load the transformer impedance still differs from 125 Ω, so the local reflection coefficient remains nonzero.

text.zh: 无损线上的正反波共同构成匹配的输入电压电流比。接受的净功率沿线守恒，内部反向波并不等于没有功率送入负载。
text.en: Forward and backward waves jointly produce the matched input V/I ratio. Net accepted power is conserved along the lossless line despite the internal backward wave.

text.zh: 因此最大功率传输与负载存在反射可以同时成立。
text.en: Maximum power transfer can therefore coexist with load reflections.

answerText.zh: 输入端整体匹配与内部反射可以同时存在。
answerText.en: Overall input matching can coexist with internal reflections.

concept.zh: 本题考查四分之一波长阻抗变换，以及相量、时域波形与功率匹配之间的联系。
concept.en: This problem links quarter-wave impedance transformation, phasors, time-domain waves and power matching.

known.zh: 原电路中 $Z_0=50\,\Omega$、$L=\lambda/4$、$R_g=50\,\Omega$、$R_L=125\,\Omega$；源幅值为 $10\,\mathrm V$，并给出了波长与频率。
known.en: The original circuit has $Z_0=50\,\Omega$, $L=\lambda/4$, $R_g=50\,\Omega$ and $R_L=125\,\Omega$. The source amplitude is $10\,\mathrm V$, and wavelength and frequency are supplied.

goal.zh: 求输入阻抗、总电压的相量和时域表达式，选择匹配用电缆，并解释匹配时为何仍可存在局部反射。
goal.en: Find input impedance and total voltage in phasor and time-domain form, choose a matching line, and explain why local reflections can remain.

approach.zh: 先用四分之一波长的特殊性质看清输入端负载，再由源端边界条件确定行波。将端口是否匹配与负载处是否反射分开讨论。
approach.en: Use the quarter-wave property to identify the impedance seen by the source, then determine the waves from the source boundary condition. Treat port matching and reflection at the load as separate questions.

topic.zh: Smith 图 · 开路支节

statement.zh: 要求使用一段开路传输线支节，将负载阻抗 $Z_L=150+j75\,\Omega$ 匹配到特性阻抗为 $Z_0=75\,\Omega$ 的馈线。单支节匹配电路如下图所示。试卷末尾附有 Smith 图，供你记录答案，并将提供直尺。
statement.en: You have been asked to match the load impedance $Z_L=150+j75\,\Omega$ to a feedline with characteristic impedance $Z_0=75\,\Omega$ by using an open-circuited transmission line stub. A diagram of the single-stub matching circuit is shown below. A Smith chart is attached to the back of your exam for recording your answers. A ruler will also be provided.

figureCaption.zh: 复刻原卷插图，保留原图的视角、结构与标注。
figureCaption.en: Recreated from the exam figure, preserving its perspective, geometry and labels.

label.zh: 阻抗归一化与 Smith 图

prompt.zh: 计算归一化负载阻抗，并在 Smith 图上标出。
prompt.en: Calculate the normalized load impedance and plot it on the Smith chart.

text.zh: 先写归一化定义。这里 z 为无量纲负载阻抗，参考阻抗取该题馈线的 Z₀。
text.en: Begin with normalization. The load impedance z is dimensionless and referenced to the feedline Z₀.

text.zh: 把复负载的实部和虚部分别除以 Z₀，保留电抗的正号。
text.en: Divide the real and imaginary parts by Z₀ separately, preserving the positive reactance.

text.zh: 在 Smith 阻抗图中找 r=Re(zL) 圆与 x=Im(zL)>0 弧的交点；也可用反射系数验证坐标。
text.en: On the impedance chart intersect the r=Re(zL) circle with the positive-x reactance arc; verify the plotted coordinate with the reflection coefficient.

text.zh: 将已归一化的复数代入，得到该点的 Γ 平面坐标；它位于上半平面。
text.en: Substitute the normalized complex impedance to obtain its Γ-plane coordinate, in the upper half-plane.

prompt.zh: 在 Smith 图上标出归一化负载导纳，并展示如何从已标出的归一化负载阻抗确定它。写出从 Smith 图上读到的归一化负载导纳。
prompt.en: Plot the normalized load admittance on the Smith chart and show how you determined it from the plotted normalized load impedance. Write down the normalized load admittance you found from the Smith chart.

text.zh: 先写归一化导纳定义，再代入 Y=1/Z，说明为什么结果是 1/zL。
text.en: Begin with normalized admittance and substitute Y=1/Z to show why it equals 1/zL.

text.zh: 复数取倒数要乘共轭数；分母变成实部平方加虚部平方。
text.en: Take the complex reciprocal by multiplying by the conjugate; the denominator becomes the sum of squared components.

text.zh: 在同一阻抗网格上读取导纳时，表示坐标应关于图心反转，即旋转 180°。这不是让实际负载的反射改变符号。
text.en: Reading admittance on the same impedance grid requires reversing the displayed point through the center, a 180° rotation; the actual load reflection does not change sign.

text.zh: 因此沿同一个等模圆转到对径点，再读出电导与电纳；代数倒数与图上结果一致。
text.en: Move to the diametrically opposite point on the same magnitude circle and read conductance and susceptance; the algebraic reciprocal verifies the chart.

prompt.zh: 计算开路支节应放置在距负载多远的位置 $d_1$（用波长表示），并给出该处传输线的输入导纳 $y_d$。在 Smith 图上展示确定这一数值所需的全部过程。
prompt.en: Calculate the distance $d_1$ (in terms of wavelength) from the load where the open-circuited stub should be placed, and give the input admittance $y_d$ of the transmission line at that point. Show all necessary work on the Smith chart for how you determined this value.

text.zh: 先从原表输入阻抗式取倒数并归一化，得到向源移动距离 d 后的输入导纳。
text.en: Begin by taking the reciprocal of the crib input-impedance equation and normalizing to obtain admittance a distance d toward the source.

text.zh: 把负载导纳分成 g+jb，将分母写成实部 1−bt 与虚部 gt。
text.en: Write load admittance as g+jb and express the denominator with real part 1−bt and imaginary part gt.

text.zh: 乘分母共轭数，单独取实部。匹配实部要求实际输入电导等于 Y₀，即归一化实部等于 1。
text.en: Multiply by the denominator conjugate and take the real part. Matching conductance to Y₀ requires normalized real part one.

text.zh: 展开分母并把右边移到左边，得到可逐项代入的二次方程。
text.en: Expand the denominator and collect terms to obtain the quadratic for substitution.

text.zh: 把本题的 g、b 代入并求根；两个根对应 Smith 图与 g=1 圆的两个交点。
text.en: Substitute this load’s g and b and solve. The two roots correspond to the intersections with the g=1 circle on the Smith chart.

text.zh: 列出两个 t 值，再由 t=tan(2πd/λ) 选 0≤d<λ/2 的分支。
text.en: List both t values, then choose branches satisfying 0≤d<λ/2 using t=tan(2πd/λ).

text.zh: 反正切的负值要加 π 后再除以 2π；距离按 λ/2 周期重复。图上对应从负载向源顺时针旋转。
text.en: For a negative arctangent add π before dividing by 2π. Distances repeat modulo λ/2; on the chart rotate clockwise toward the source.

text.zh: 把两个距离对应的 t 代回输入导纳式，验证实部确为 1，并保留待抵消的虚部。
text.en: Substitute each t back into the admittance formula to verify real part one and retain the susceptance to be cancelled.

text.zh: 选第一组非负距离作为本页主答案；另一分支仍是有效匹配方案。
text.en: Choose the first nonnegative distance as the primary solution; the other branch is also valid.

note.zh: 另一有效分支为 d=0.375λ、yd=1−j。所有距离按 λ/2 周期重复。
note.en: The other branch is d=0.375λ with yd=1−j. Distances repeat modulo λ/2.

figureCaption.zh: 阻抗与导纳在同一 Smith 网格上的对径点、g=1 的两个交点及第一组匹配旋转。
figureCaption.en: Diametrically opposite impedance/admittance chart points, both g=1 intersections, and the first matching rotation.

prompt.zh: 计算匹配源所需的支节长度 $l_1$（用波长表示），并给出该长度开路支节的输入导纳 $y_s$。在 Smith 图上展示确定这一数值所需的全部过程。
prompt.en: Calculate the length $l_1$ (in terms of wavelength) of the stub needed to match the source, and give the input admittance $y_s$ of the open-circuited stub of that length. Show all necessary work on the Smith chart for how you determined this value.

text.zh: 先写原表开路传输线阻抗，再取倒数并用 Y₀=1/Z₀ 归一化。
text.en: Begin with the crib open-line impedance, then invert and normalize with Y₀=1/Z₀.

text.zh: 支节并联时导纳相加，目标是总归一化导纳为 1。若主线为 1+jB，支节必须为 −jB。
text.en: Parallel admittances add and the target total is one. If the main line is 1+jB, the stub must supply −jB.

text.zh: 代入 c) 选中分支的电纳，列出需要满足的正切方程。
text.en: Insert the susceptance of the selected branch from c) and write the tangent equation.

text.zh: 选最小非负的开路支节长度；正切为负时使用第二象限的电长度。
text.en: Choose the smallest nonnegative open-stub length; a negative tangent requires a second-quadrant electrical length.

text.zh: 核对虚部恰好抵消；若改用另一主线交点，必须同时改用配套的支节长度。
text.en: Check exact susceptance cancellation. Choosing the other main-line intersection also requires its corresponding stub length.

text.zh: 本页所选分支的开路支节参数如下。
text.en: The open-stub parameters for the selected branch are:

concept.zh: 本题考查 Smith 图上的阻抗与导纳转换，以及并联开路支节匹配。
concept.en: This problem uses Smith-chart impedance/admittance conversion and a parallel open-circuit matching stub.

known.zh: 负载为 $Z_L=(150+j75)\,\Omega$，馈线与支节的特性阻抗为 $75\,\Omega$，支节终端开路。
known.en: The load is $Z_L=(150+j75)\,\Omega$, the lines have characteristic impedance $75\,\Omega$, and the stub is open-circuited.

goal.zh: 依次找出归一化负载阻抗、导纳、支节接入距离和支节长度，并在图上说明过程。
goal.en: Locate the normalized load impedance and admittance, then find the stub position and length with the construction shown on the chart.

approach.zh: 并联结构用导纳相加最直接。先把负载转为导纳，沿等反射系数圆转到实部匹配的位置，再让开路支节补偿剩余的虚部。
approach.en: Admittances add directly in a parallel network. Convert the load to admittance, rotate along its constant-reflection circle until the real part matches, then cancel the remaining imaginary part with the open stub.

topic.zh: 参数测量 · 低损耗线

statement.zh: 给你一卷长度为 $L=100\mathrm{m}$ 的同轴电缆，要求通过测量确定其性质。测量装置如下图所示。假设可将同轴电缆视为低损耗传输线。
statement.en: You are given a spool of coaxial cable of length $L=100\mathrm{m}$ and are tasked with determining its properties through measurements. A diagram of your measurement setup is shown below. Assume the coaxial cable can be treated as a low-loss transmission line.

figureCaption.zh: 复刻原卷插图，保留原图的视角、结构与标注。
figureCaption.en: Recreated from the exam figure, preserving its perspective, geometry and labels.

prompt.zh: 测得电缆的时间延迟为 $T_d=392\mathrm{ns}$。这根同轴电缆的速度因子是多少？
prompt.en: You measure the time delay of your cable to be $T_d=392\mathrm{ns}$. What is the velocity factor of the coaxial cable?

text.zh: 先写传播距离、单程时间与波速的关系，再用速度因子的定义。
text.en: Begin with the distance, one-way time and speed relation, then the velocity-factor definition.

text.zh: 将长度和测得时延统一为米与秒。
text.en: Express length and measured delay in meters and seconds.

text.zh: 代入距离除以时间，先求实际传播速度。
text.en: Substitute distance divided by time to compute the propagation speed first.

text.zh: 再除以真空光速，速度因子没有单位。
text.en: Divide by vacuum light speed to obtain a dimensionless factor.

prompt.zh: 不论将 $V_g$ 设为何种频率，测得同轴电缆输入电压 $V_{in}$ 的幅值均为 $1\mathrm{V}$。这根电缆的特性阻抗 $Z_0$ 是多少？
prompt.en: You measure the amplitude of the voltage at the input to the coaxial cable $V_{in}$ to be $1\mathrm{V}$ for any frequency you set for $V_g$. What is the characteristic impedance $Z_0$ of the cable?

text.zh: 先写反射系数与输入阻抗原式，识别随频率变化的驻波来源。
text.en: Begin with the reflection and input-impedance equations to identify frequency-dependent standing-wave behavior.

text.zh: 扫频改变 βL；若有明显负载失配，输入阻抗通常随频率改变，源端分压也会改变。
text.en: Sweeping frequency changes βL. With load mismatch, input impedance and hence the source divider generally vary with frequency.

text.zh: 按题设固定源和低损耗近似，输入幅度不随扫频变化，采用官方的匹配推断 ΓL≈0。
text.en: For the stated fixed-source, low-loss model, follow the official inference that constant input amplitude indicates ΓL≈0.

text.zh: 负载是 50 Ω，所以推断出的特性阻抗也是约 50 Ω。
text.en: The 50 Ω load therefore implies approximately the same characteristic impedance.

prompt.zh: 若发生器的频率为 $f=100\mathrm{MHz}=100\times10^6\,\mathrm{Hz}$，计算同轴电缆上电压波的波长 $\lambda$。
prompt.en: Calculate the wavelength $\lambda$ of the voltage wave on the coaxial cable if the frequency of the generator is $f=100\mathrm{MHz}=100\times10^6\,\mathrm{Hz}$.

text.zh: 先写公式表的波长与波速关系。
text.en: Begin with the crib wavelength–speed relation.

text.zh: 使用 a) 从时延测出的未舍入波速，并把频率换成 Hz。
text.en: Use the unrounded speed measured in a) and convert frequency to Hz.

text.zh: 代入数值，s⁻¹ 与 m/s 中的时间单位约去。
text.en: Substitute the values and cancel the time units.

text.zh: 按题目要求保留至少两位有效数字。
text.en: Retain at least the two significant digits requested.

prompt.zh: 计算同轴电缆的单位长度电感 $l$ 和单位长度电容 $c$。
prompt.en: Calculate the per-unit-inductance $l$ and per-unit-capacitance $c$ of the coaxial cable.

text.zh: 先写需要联立的两条原表公式；低损耗近似下使用无损线的 Z₀ 与波速关系。
text.en: Begin with both crib equations, using the lossless relations for Z₀ and speed in the low-loss approximation.

text.zh: 将 Z₀ 除以 u，根号相乘后只剩 l；将 Z₀ 乘 u 得到 1/c。
text.en: Divide Z₀ by u to isolate l; multiply Z₀ by u to obtain 1/c.

text.zh: 先代入求每单位长度电感，保留 H/m 单位。
text.en: Substitute to obtain inductance per unit length, retaining H/m.

text.zh: 再独立代入求电容，不要把分母中的 Z₀ 漏掉。
text.en: Substitute separately for capacitance, retaining Z₀ in the denominator.

text.zh: 把 H、F 分别换为 nH、pF；此处沿用未舍入时延，原解的微小差别来自中间舍入。
text.en: Convert H and F to nH and pF. The small difference from the official inductance comes from its intermediate rounding.

note.zh: 使用未舍入的 392 ns 得 l=196.0 nH/m；官方先取 vf=0.85 得 196.1 nH/m，属于舍入差异。
note.en: Using the unrounded 392 ns gives l=196.0 nH/m. The official 196.1 nH/m uses vf rounded to 0.85.

prompt.zh: 若测得负载电压幅值为 $V(L=100\mathrm{m})=0.904\mathrm{V}$，输入电压幅值为 $V(L=0\mathrm{m})=1\mathrm{V}$，求衰减系数 $\alpha$。
prompt.en: If you measure the amplitude of the voltage at the load to be $V(L=100\mathrm{m})=0.904\mathrm{V}$ and the amplitude of the voltage at the input to be $V(L=0\mathrm{m})=1\mathrm{V}$, determine the attenuation coefficient $\alpha$.

text.zh: 先写有损行波包络。负载匹配时幅度之比直接给出单程指数衰减。
text.en: Begin with the lossy-wave envelope; with a matched load, the amplitude ratio gives one-way exponential attenuation.

text.zh: 把两个测得幅度及线长代入，先形成无量纲比值。
text.en: Substitute the measured amplitudes and length, forming a dimensionless ratio first.

text.zh: 两边取自然对数；指数的负号不能省去。
text.en: Take natural logarithms on both sides, keeping the minus sign.

text.zh: 再除以负的长度系数，得到正衰减常数。
text.en: Divide by the negative length coefficient to obtain a positive attenuation constant.

text.zh: 幅度的指数衰减用 Np/m 表示，不是功率衰减或 dB/m。
text.en: This amplitude attenuation is in Np/m, rather than a power coefficient or dB/m.

prompt.zh: 计算同轴电缆的单位长度电阻 $r$。
prompt.en: Calculate the per-unit-length resistance $r$ of the coaxial cable.

text.zh: 先写原表低损耗衰减公式。按该题模型忽略并联漏电导 g。
text.en: Begin with the crib low-loss attenuation equation, neglecting shunt conductance g in this model.

text.zh: 两边乘 2Z₀，先解出未知串联电阻密度。
text.en: Multiply both sides by 2Z₀ to isolate series resistance per length.

text.zh: 代入未舍入的衰减系数和 b) 的 50 Ω 特性阻抗。
text.en: Insert the unrounded attenuation and the 50 Ω characteristic impedance from b).

text.zh: 化简并检查单位是 Ω/m。
text.en: Simplify and check the units are Ω/m.

concept.zh: 本题是从实验读数反推传输线参数：传播、匹配和衰减需要依次联系起来。
concept.en: This problem works backward from measurements to the propagation, matching and loss parameters of a transmission line.

known.zh: 电缆长 $100\,\mathrm m$，测得延迟 $392\,\mathrm{ns}$；图中 $R_g=25\,\Omega$、$R_L=50\,\Omega$，输入电压幅值不随频率变化。后续给出频率及输入、输出幅值。
known.en: The cable is $100\,\mathrm m$ long with measured delay $392\,\mathrm{ns}$. The circuit has $R_g=25\,\Omega$ and $R_L=50\,\Omega$, and the input-voltage magnitude is independent of frequency. Later parts supply frequency and endpoint amplitudes.

goal.zh: 求速度因子、$Z_0$、波长、单位长度电感与电容，再由幅值衰减求 $\alpha$ 和单位长度电阻。
goal.en: Find velocity factor, $Z_0$, wavelength and distributed inductance and capacitance; then infer $\alpha$ and resistance per unit length from attenuation.

approach.zh: 先由长度和延迟确定波速，再利用频率无关的输入测量判断匹配。最后处理损耗，注意电压幅值的衰减指数与功率的衰减指数不同。
approach.en: Find speed from length and delay, then interpret the frequency-independent input measurement to identify matching. Handle loss afterward, keeping voltage-amplitude attenuation distinct from power attenuation.

topic.zh: 瞬态 · 反弹图

statement.zh: 一根特性阻抗为 $Z_0=50\Omega$、时间延迟为 $T_d=50\mathrm{ps}$ 的传输线，连接在电压为 $V_g=10\mathrm{V}$、源阻抗为 $R_g=30\Omega$ 的发生器电路与负载阻抗 $Z_L=150\Omega$ 之间，如下图所示。开关在 $t=0$ 闭合，向传输线施加直流电压。
statement.en: A transmission line of characteristic impedance $Z_0=50\Omega$ and time delay $T_d=50\mathrm{ps}$ is connected between a generator circuit with voltage $V_g=10\mathrm{V}$ and generator impedance $R_g=30\Omega$, and a load impedance $Z_L=150\Omega$, as shown below. The switch closes at time $t=0$ and provides a DC voltage to the transmission line.

figureCaption.zh: 复刻原卷插图，保留原图的视角、结构与标注。
figureCaption.en: Recreated from the exam figure, preserving its perspective, geometry and labels.

prompt.zh:
计算下列量：
• 负载端反射系数 $\Gamma_L$
• 发生器端反射系数 $\Gamma_g$
prompt.en:
Calculate the following quantities:
• The reflection coefficient at the load $\Gamma_L$
• The reflection coefficient at the generator $\Gamma_g$

text.zh: 先写原表的端点电压反射系数；负载端和源端都以同一个线路 Z₀ 为参考。
text.en: Begin with the crib endpoint voltage reflection coefficient, referencing both ends to the same line Z₀.

text.zh: 负载端代入 150 Ω 和 50 Ω，先算差再算和。
text.en: At the load insert 150 Ω and 50 Ω, evaluating the difference and sum separately.

text.zh: 源端返回波看到 30 Ω 源电阻，因此对应系数为负。
text.en: A wave returning to the source sees its 30 Ω resistance, giving a negative coefficient.

text.zh: 两系数均为电压比，无量纲；负号表示源端反射电压反相。
text.en: Both coefficients are dimensionless voltage ratios; the negative sign indicates voltage inversion at the source.

prompt.en: Calculate numerical values for $V_1^+$, $V_1^-$, $V_2^+$ and $V_2^-$ in the bounce diagram below.

text.zh: 先写初始分压和反射递推式，再按传播顺序逐个计算。
text.en: Begin with the launch divider and reflection recurrence, then evaluate in propagation order.

text.zh: t=0 时把 10 V、30 Ω、50 Ω 代入，得到第一正向阶跃。
text.en: At t=0 substitute 10 V, 30 Ω and 50 Ω to obtain the first forward step.

text.zh: 50 ps 时到达负载，第一反向波乘负载反射系数 +0.5。
text.en: At 50 ps the wave reaches the load; multiply by +0.5 for the first backward wave.

text.zh: 100 ps 时反向波到源，再乘 −0.25，得到第二正向阶跃。
text.en: At 100 ps the return reaches the source; multiply by −0.25 for the second forward step.

text.zh: 150 ps 时第二正向阶跃到负载，再乘 +0.5；两次反射的负号不能丢失。
text.en: At 150 ps the second forward step reaches the load; multiply by +0.5, retaining its negative sign.

text.zh: 把四个行波幅度标在反弹图对应的四条轨迹上。
text.en: Label these four traveling-wave amplitudes on their four bounce trajectories.

steps.math: \begin{gathered}V_1^+=6.25\,\mathrm V,\quad V_1^-=3.125\,\mathrm V\\V_2^+=-0.78125\,\mathrm V,\quad V_2^-=-0.390625\,\mathrm V\end{gathered}

parts.answer: \begin{gathered}V_1^+=6.25\,\mathrm V,\quad V_1^-=3.125\,\mathrm V\\V_2^+=-0.78125\,\mathrm V,\quad V_2^-=-0.390625\,\mathrm V\end{gathered}

prompt.zh: 画出 $0\le t\le150\mathrm{ps}$ 内负载电压 $V(z=L)$ 随时间变化的曲线。标注电压幅值和关键时刻，例如电压波发生相关反射的时刻。
prompt.en: Sketch a plot of the voltage at the load $V(z=L)$ vs. time for $0\le t\le150\mathrm{ps}$. Label voltage amplitudes and critical times, such as when the voltage wave undergoes relevant reflections.

text.zh: 先写每次到达负载所增加的电压：入射阶跃与即时反射阶跃相加。
text.en: Begin with each load voltage increment: add the arriving step and its immediate reflected step.

text.zh: 第一行波传播时间为 50 ps，未到达前，负载处仍没有电压变化。
text.en: The first transit takes 50 ps, so the load voltage remains unchanged before that arrival.

text.zh: 50 ps 到达时代入 V₁⁺ 与 ΓL，求第一次阶跃后的平台值。
text.en: At 50 ps substitute V₁⁺ and ΓL to obtain the first plateau.

text.zh: 100 ps 的反射发生在源端；还需再传播 50 ps 才影响负载，所以中间平台保持不变。
text.en: The 100 ps reflection occurs at the source and needs another 50 ps to affect the load, so the intermediate plateau stays unchanged.

text.zh: 150 ps 第二次入射带来负的增量。源持续接通，所以新平台要在旧平台上累加。
text.en: The second arrival at 150 ps gives a negative increment. With the source still on, add it to the existing plateau.

text.zh: 将增量加到 9.375 V，按右连续理想阶跃标记端点。
text.en: Add the increment to 9.375 V and mark right-continuous ideal-step values.

figureCaption.zh: 负载电压在 50 ps 上升至 9.375 V，在 150 ps 降至 8.203125 V。
figureCaption.en: Load voltage rises to 9.375 V at 50 ps and falls to 8.203125 V at 150 ps.

prompt.zh: 计算传输线达到稳态后的电压 $V_{ss}$。
prompt.en: Calculate the voltage on the transmission line after it has reached steady state $V_{ss}$.

text.zh: 持续 DC 的最终稳态中，无损传输线等效为理想连接；用串联回路的电压定律开始推导。
text.en: At final sustained-DC steady state the lossless line is an ideal connection. Begin with the series-loop voltage law.

text.zh: 先求最终电流，再乘负载电阻。
text.en: Solve for final current, then multiply by the load resistance.

text.zh: 代入 10 V、30 Ω 和 150 Ω。
text.en: Substitute 10 V, 30 Ω and 150 Ω.

text.zh: 也可对反弹图求和：第一负载增量为 9.375 V，每次往返乘 ΓgΓL=−1/8。
text.en: Alternatively sum the bounce increments: the first is 9.375 V and each round trip multiplies it by ΓgΓL=−1/8.

text.zh: 级数求和与 DC 电路分压完全一致。
text.en: The geometric sum agrees with the DC circuit divider.

concept.zh: 本题考查持续直流阶跃在失配传输线上的反弹过程，以及暂态与稳态的区别。
concept.en: This problem distinguishes the transient reflections of a sustained DC step from the eventual steady state.

known.zh: $V_g=10\,\mathrm V$、$R_g=30\,\Omega$、$Z_0=50\,\Omega$、$R_L=150\,\Omega$，单程延迟 $T_d=50\,\mathrm{ps}$；开关闭合后电源持续接通。
known.en: The sustained source has $V_g=10\,\mathrm V$, $R_g=30\,\Omega$, $Z_0=50\,\Omega$ and $R_L=150\,\Omega$, with one-way delay $T_d=50\,\mathrm{ps}$.

goal.zh: 求两端反射系数和前几次行波，画出指定时间内的负载电压，再求稳态电压。
goal.en: Find both reflection coefficients and the first traveling waves, plot the specified load-voltage history, and find the steady-state voltage.

approach.zh: 先求初始发射波，再按到达端点的时刻逐次反射。负载电压是入射波与反射波的和；长时间结果还应与直流等效电路相符。
approach.en: Start with the launched wave and reflect it at each arrival time. Load voltage combines incident and reflected waves; the long-time limit should agree with the DC equivalent circuit.

text.en: A half-wave line of 25, 50 or 75 Ω repeats the 100 Ω load as a 100 Ω input, matching the source.

text.zh: 先由速度因子和频率计算电缆内波长。

text.zh: 取一个半波的正长度即可完成所需匹配。

text.zh: 先把串联电阻与电容合并为负载阻抗，再用四分之一波长性质变换。
text.en: First combine the series resistor and capacitor as the load, then use the quarter-wave property.

text.zh: 由频率求角频率，并把 1 μF 写为 10⁻⁶ F。
text.en: Calculate angular frequency and express 1 μF as 10⁻⁶ F.

text.zh: 利用 1/j=−j 求电容阻抗，并与 50 Ω 相加。
text.en: Use 1/j=−j for the capacitor impedance and add the 50 Ω resistor.

text.zh: 代入原表反演式，再乘分母共轭数，显示虚部符号为何反转。
text.en: Substitute into the crib inversion and multiply by the denominator conjugate to show the imaginary-sign reversal.

text.zh: Xc² 远小于 50²，因此实部约为 50 Ω，虚部为小的正电抗。
text.en: Since Xc² is negligible relative to 50², the real part is approximately 50 Ω with a small positive reactance.

prompt.zh: 下图电路中，开路电缆长度 $\ell$ 为多少时，会使电压波在 $z=A$ 处全反射？
prompt.en: In the circuit below, what length of open-circuited cable $\ell$ would lead to full reflection of the voltage wave at $z=A$?

text.zh: 先写原表的开路支节输入阻抗。要使有电阻负载的并联节点全反射，可把支节输入变成短路。
text.en: Begin with the crib open-stub impedance. To obtain total reflection at a shunt node with a resistive load contribution, make the stub input a short.

text.zh: 令支节输入阻抗为零，即 cot(βℓ)=0，选择最短正电长度 π/2。
text.en: Set the stub input to zero, requiring cot(βℓ)=0; choose the shortest positive electrical length π/2.

text.zh: 短路支节并联任何有限负载都会把节点 A 的总阻抗压为零。
text.en: A shorted shunt branch makes the total impedance at A zero for any finite parallel load.

text.zh: 将节点阻抗代入反射系数原式；电压反相，模为 1。
text.en: Substitute the node impedance into the reflection equation; voltage reverses sign and the magnitude is one.

text.zh: 由共同速度因子和频率求得 λ=0.975 m，再取四分之一波长。
text.en: The common velocity factor and frequency give λ=0.975 m; take one quarter of it.

concept.zh: 本题通过不同电路考查传输线的阻抗变换、匹配和开路支节的滤波作用。
concept.en: These circuits test impedance transformation, matching and the filtering action of an open-circuit stub.

known.zh: 所有电路均有 $f=200\,\mathrm{MHz}$、速度因子 $0.65$；第 a) 问可选 $25\,\Omega$、$50\,\Omega$、$75\,\Omega$ 电缆，各电路的连接与终端见原图。
known.en: All circuits operate at $200\,\mathrm{MHz}$ with velocity factor $0.65$. Part a offers $25\,\Omega$, $50\,\Omega$ and $75\,\Omega$ cables; each diagram supplies its connections and terminations.

goal.zh: 选出匹配所需的电缆类型和实际长度，计算指定输入阻抗，并确定使主线发生全反射的支节长度。
goal.en: Select cable type and physical length for matching, calculate the specified input impedance, and choose a stub length that produces total reflection.

approach.zh: 先把电长度与米数联系起来，再识别半波、四分之一波等特殊长度。遇到并联支节时改用导纳，先判断接点实际呈现开路还是短路。
approach.en: Relate electrical length to physical length, then recognize half-wave and quarter-wave properties. For a parallel stub, use admittance and identify whether the junction effectively sees an open or a short.

title.zh: 利用 Smith 图的单支节匹配
title.en: Single-Stub Matching with a Smith Chart

topic.zh: Smith 图 · 开路支节

statement.zh: 使用所附 Smith 图，通过单支节匹配法将馈线的特性阻抗 $Z_0$ 与负载阻抗 $Z_L$ 匹配。如下图所示，匹配电路包含一段连接负载、长度为 $d$ 的直通线，以及一段与直通线并联、长度为 $\ell$ 的开路支节。本题所有传输线均有 $Z_0=50\Omega$。
statement.en: Use the included Smith chart to match the feedline’s characteristic impedance $Z_0$ to the load impedance $Z_L$ via the single-stub matching method. As shown below, the matching circuit consists of a through-line of length $d$, which is connected to the load and an open-circuited stub of length $\ell$, connected in parallel with the through-line. $Z_0=50\Omega$ for all transmission lines in this problem.

label.zh: 阻抗归一化与 Smith 图

prompt.zh: 计算归一化负载阻抗 $z_L$，并在 Smith 图上标出。
prompt.en: Calculate the normalized load impedance $z_L$ and plot it on the Smith chart.

text.zh: 先写归一化定义。这里 z 为无量纲负载阻抗，参考阻抗取该题馈线的 Z₀。
text.en: Begin with normalization. The load impedance z is dimensionless and referenced to the feedline Z₀.

text.zh: 把复负载的实部和虚部分别除以 Z₀，保留电抗的正号。
text.en: Divide the real and imaginary parts by Z₀ separately, preserving the positive reactance.

text.zh: 在 Smith 阻抗图中找 r=Re(zL) 圆与 x=Im(zL)>0 弧的交点；也可用反射系数验证坐标。
text.en: On the impedance chart intersect the r=Re(zL) circle with the positive-x reactance arc; verify the plotted coordinate with the reflection coefficient.

text.zh: 将已归一化的复数代入，得到该点的 Γ 平面坐标；它位于上半平面。
text.en: Substitute the normalized complex impedance to obtain its Γ-plane coordinate, in the upper half-plane.

prompt.zh: 确定并在 Smith 图上标出归一化负载导纳 $y_L$ 的位置，然后读出其数值。
prompt.en: Determine and plot the location of the normalized load admittance $y_L$ on the Smith chart, then read off its numerical value.

text.zh: 先写归一化导纳定义，再代入 Y=1/Z，说明为什么结果是 1/zL。
text.en: Begin with normalized admittance and substitute Y=1/Z to show why it equals 1/zL.

text.zh: 复数取倒数要乘共轭数；分母变成实部平方加虚部平方。
text.en: Take the complex reciprocal by multiplying by the conjugate; the denominator becomes the sum of squared components.

text.zh: 在同一阻抗网格上读取导纳时，表示坐标应关于图心反转，即旋转 180°。这不是让实际负载的反射改变符号。
text.en: Reading admittance on the same impedance grid requires reversing the displayed point through the center, a 180° rotation; the actual load reflection does not change sign.

text.zh: 因此沿同一个等模圆转到对径点，再读出电导与电纳；代数倒数与图上结果一致。
text.en: Move to the diametrically opposite point on the same magnitude circle and read conductance and susceptance; the algebraic reciprocal verifies the chart.

prompt.zh: 确定直通线的长度 $d$，使其输入导纳的实部与特性导纳 $Y_0=1/Z_0$ 匹配（即 $y_d=1+jA$）。在 Smith 图上展示确定这一长度的全部过程。答案可以用波长表示。
prompt.en: Determine the length of the through-line $d$ that yields an input admittance whose real part is matched to the characteristic admittance $Y_0=1/Z_0$ (i.e. $y_d=1+jA$). Show all work for how you determined this length on the Smith chart. You may leave your answer in terms of wavelengths.

text.zh: 先从原表输入阻抗式取倒数并归一化，得到向源移动距离 d 后的输入导纳。
text.en: Begin by taking the reciprocal of the crib input-impedance equation and normalizing to obtain admittance a distance d toward the source.

text.zh: 把负载导纳分成 g+jb，将分母写成实部 1−bt 与虚部 gt。
text.en: Write load admittance as g+jb and express the denominator with real part 1−bt and imaginary part gt.

text.zh: 乘分母共轭数，单独取实部。匹配实部要求实际输入电导等于 Y₀，即归一化实部等于 1。
text.en: Multiply by the denominator conjugate and take the real part. Matching conductance to Y₀ requires normalized real part one.

text.zh: 展开分母并把右边移到左边，得到可逐项代入的二次方程。
text.en: Expand the denominator and collect terms to obtain the quadratic for substitution.

text.zh: 把本题的 g、b 代入并求根；两个根对应 Smith 图与 g=1 圆的两个交点。
text.en: Substitute this load’s g and b and solve. The two roots correspond to the intersections with the g=1 circle on the Smith chart.

text.zh: 列出两个 t 值，再由 t=tan(2πd/λ) 选 0≤d<λ/2 的分支。
text.en: List both t values, then choose branches satisfying 0≤d<λ/2 using t=tan(2πd/λ).

text.zh: 反正切的负值要加 π 后再除以 2π；距离按 λ/2 周期重复。图上对应从负载向源顺时针旋转。
text.en: For a negative arctangent add π before dividing by 2π. Distances repeat modulo λ/2; on the chart rotate clockwise toward the source.

text.zh: 把两个距离对应的 t 代回输入导纳式，验证实部确为 1，并保留待抵消的虚部。
text.en: Substitute each t back into the admittance formula to verify real part one and retain the susceptance to be cancelled.

text.zh: 选第一组非负距离作为本页主答案；另一分支仍是有效匹配方案。
text.en: Choose the first nonnegative distance as the primary solution; the other branch is also valid.

note.zh: 核对：官方图给出 d≈0.271λ、ℓ≈0.305λ、b≈2.82，另一分支写 d≈0.318λ。直接代入给定 zL=0.5+j1.8 后，精确结果为本页数值；另一分支 d=0.378411λ、ℓ=0.192411λ。已用输入导纳方程独立校验。
note.en: Check: the official chart gives d≈0.271λ, ℓ≈0.305λ, b≈2.82 and an alternative d≈0.318λ. Direct substitution of zL=0.5+j1.8 gives the values here; the other exact branch is d=0.378411λ, ℓ=0.192411λ. Both are independently checked with the input-admittance equation.

figureCaption.zh: 按给定负载精确计算的导纳 Smith 图；两组匹配结果在推导中分别核验。
figureCaption.en: Admittance Smith chart computed from the stated load; both matching branches are checked in the derivation.

prompt.zh: 确定完成阻抗匹配所需的开路支节长度 $\ell$。在 Smith 图上展示确定这一长度的全部过程。答案可以用波长表示。
prompt.en: Determine the length of the open-circuited stub $\ell$ that completes the impedance match. Show all work for how you determined this length on the Smith chart. You may leave your answer in terms of wavelengths.

text.zh: 先写原表开路传输线阻抗，再取倒数并用 Y₀=1/Z₀ 归一化。
text.en: Begin with the crib open-line impedance, then invert and normalize with Y₀=1/Z₀.

text.zh: 支节并联时导纳相加，目标是总归一化导纳为 1。若主线为 1+jB，支节必须为 −jB。
text.en: Parallel admittances add and the target total is one. If the main line is 1+jB, the stub must supply −jB.

text.zh: 代入 c) 选中分支的电纳，列出需要满足的正切方程。
text.en: Insert the susceptance of the selected branch from c) and write the tangent equation.

text.zh: 选最小非负的开路支节长度；正切为负时使用第二象限的电长度。
text.en: Choose the smallest nonnegative open-stub length; a negative tangent requires a second-quadrant electrical length.

text.zh: 核对虚部恰好抵消；若改用另一主线交点，必须同时改用配套的支节长度。
text.en: Check exact susceptance cancellation. Choosing the other main-line intersection also requires its corresponding stub length.

text.zh: 本页所选分支的开路支节参数如下。
text.en: The open-stub parameters for the selected branch are:

concept.zh: 本题考查用 Smith 图完成单支节匹配，重点是并联时应使用导纳。
concept.en: This problem constructs a single-stub match on the Smith chart, using admittance for the parallel connection.

known.zh: 负载为 $Z_L=(25+j90)\,\Omega$，所有线段均有 $Z_0=50\,\Omega$，匹配支节开路。
known.en: The load is $Z_L=(25+j90)\,\Omega$, all line sections have $Z_0=50\,\Omega$, and the matching stub is open-circuited.

goal.zh: 求归一化阻抗、导纳，以及直通线距离和开路支节长度，并标出 Smith 图上的读数过程。
goal.en: Find normalized impedance and admittance, then the through-line distance and open-stub length, showing the Smith-chart readings.

approach.zh: 归一化后先作阻抗到导纳的中心对称转换，再向发生器方向旋转到电导匹配处。此时支节只需补偿电纳，注意两条可行分支与读数方向。
approach.en: Normalize, reflect through the chart center to convert impedance to admittance, then rotate toward the generator to match conductance. The stub cancels susceptance; keep track of both branches and the direction of the wavelength scale.

topic.zh: 传输线模型 · 瞬态

statement.zh:
下方传输线模型由长度为 $\Delta z\ll\lambda$ 的小段组成，其电路元件参数如下：
• $l=0.3125\,\mathrm{\mu H/m}=3.125\times10^{-7}\,\mathrm{H/m}$
• $c=55.6\,\mathrm{pF/m}=5.56\times10^{-11}\,\mathrm{F/m}$
statement.en:
The transmission line model below consists of segments of length $\Delta z\ll\lambda$ and the following circuit element parameters:
• $l=0.3125\,\mathrm{\mu H/m}=3.125\times10^{-7}\,\mathrm{H/m}$
• $c=55.6\,\mathrm{pF/m}=5.56\times10^{-11}\,\mathrm{F/m}$

figureCaption.zh: 复刻原卷插图，保留原图的视角、结构与标注。
figureCaption.en: Recreated from the exam figure, preserving its perspective, geometry and labels.

prompt.zh: 上方模型表示的传输线是有损线还是无损线？简要解释。
prompt.en: Is the transmission line that is represented by the model above a lossy transmission line or a lossless transmission line? Briefly explain.

text.zh: 先写传播常数的分布参数表达式，实部 α 表示衰减。
text.en: Begin with propagation constant in terms of distributed parameters; its real part α is attenuation.

text.zh: 逐项检查原图：只有串联电感 lΔz 和并联电容 cΔz，没有耗散元件 rΔz 或 gΔz。
text.en: Inspect the original cell: it contains series lΔz and shunt cΔz, with no dissipative rΔz or gΔz elements.

text.zh: 把零电阻、零漏电导代入传播常数，得到纯虚数。
text.en: Insert zero resistance and conductance to obtain a purely imaginary propagation constant.

text.zh: 因此该模型是无损线；电感和电容交换储能，没有电阻性平均功率损耗。
text.en: The model is lossless: inductors and capacitors exchange stored energy with no resistive average power dissipation.

prompt.zh: 计算传输线的速度因子和特性阻抗。
prompt.en: Calculate the velocity factor and characteristic impedance of the transmission line.

text.zh: 先写原表的无损线波速、特性阻抗和速度因子定义。
text.en: Begin with the crib lossless speed, characteristic impedance and velocity-factor relations.

text.zh: 先将每单位长度参数转为 SI 单位，再代入乘积。
text.en: Convert the per-length parameters to SI units, then form their product.

text.zh: 对乘积开方后取倒数，求得波速。
text.en: Take the square root of the product and invert to obtain speed.

text.zh: 再除以真空光速，计算无量纲速度因子。
text.en: Divide by vacuum light speed for the dimensionless velocity factor.

text.zh: 独立计算 l/c 的平方根，H/F 的平方根单位是 Ω。
text.en: Independently evaluate the square root of l/c; the square root of H/F has units Ω.

text.zh: 列出两个结果。后面的反弹图按标准答案使用舍入值 Z₀≈75 Ω。
text.en: State both results. The later bounce diagram uses rounded Z₀≈75 Ω, as in the official solution.

prompt.zh: 若传输线长度为 $L=60\mathrm{m}$，计算其时间延迟 $T_d$。
prompt.en: If the transmission line length is $L=60\mathrm{m}$, calculate the time delay $T_d$ of the transmission line.

text.zh: 先写传播距离与单程时间的关系，并解出 Td。
text.en: Begin with propagation distance versus one-way time and solve for Td.

text.zh: 将 60 m 与上问未舍入的波速代入。
text.en: Substitute 60 m and the unrounded speed from the preceding part.

text.zh: 秒转换为纳秒，1 s=10⁹ ns。
text.en: Convert seconds to nanoseconds using 1 s=10⁹ ns.

text.zh: 与原解采用 vf=0.8 的 250 ns 一致到所需精度。
text.en: This agrees to the required precision with the official 250 ns using vf=0.8.

prompt.zh:
现在考虑下方直流电路，其中有一个在 $t=0$ 闭合的开关，以及一根性质与第 a) 问模型规定相同的传输线。

对下方反弹图，计算下列参数：
• 所有反射系数
• 所有电压幅值
• $t=T_d$ 时的负载电压 $V_L$
• $t=2T_d$ 时的传输线输入电压 $V_{in}$
prompt.en:
Now consider the DC circuit below, which contains a switch that closes at $t=0$, and a transmission line with the same properties as specified by the model in part a).

For the bounce diagram below, calculate the following parameters:
• All reflection coefficients
• All voltage amplitudes
• The voltage at the load $V_L$ at $t=T_d$
• The voltage at the input to the transmission line $V_{in}$ at $t=2T_d$

text.zh: 先写端点反射系数、初始分压和行波反射递推式。
text.en: Begin with endpoint reflection, the launch divider and the traveling-wave recurrence.

text.zh: 沿用标准答案舍入的 75 Ω 线路阻抗；负载为 25 Ω。
text.en: Use the official rounded line impedance of 75 Ω and the 25 Ω load.

text.zh: 源电阻同样为 75 Ω，所以返回源端的波被吸收，不再产生新正向波。
text.en: The source resistance is also 75 Ω, so returning waves are absorbed without another forward wave.

text.zh: t=0 时发出的第一正向电压由 12 V 分压求得。
text.en: Find the first forward voltage at t=0 by dividing the 12 V source.

text.zh: 在 Td≈250 ns 到达负载，反射电压因 ΓL<0 而反相。
text.en: On reaching the load at Td≈250 ns, the reflected voltage changes sign because ΓL<0.

text.zh: 在 2Td≈500 ns 返回源后，再乘 Γg=0，后续正反向行波都为零。
text.en: At 2Td≈500 ns the return reaches the source. Multiplication by Γg=0 makes subsequent traveling waves zero.

text.zh: 负载第一次到达时测到入射和即时反射的代数和。
text.en: At the first load arrival the measured voltage is the sum of incident and immediate reflected waves.

text.zh: 源是持续 DC，500 ns 后的输入电压需计入此前已有的 6 V，再加返回波和新反射波。
text.en: The source is sustained DC. At 500 ns include the existing 6 V input plus the return and its new reflection.

text.zh: 所有非零幅度与端点电压都应标在反弹图上；Γg=0 后没有继续传播的非零轨迹。
text.en: Label all nonzero traveling amplitudes and measured endpoint voltages; after Γg=0 there is no further nonzero traveling trajectory.

figureCaption.zh: 采用 Z₀≈75 Ω 的反弹图：负载反射 −3 V，源端匹配并吸收返回波，两个测量电压均为 3 V。
figureCaption.en: Bounce diagram using Z₀≈75 Ω: −3 V load reflection, matched-source absorption, and 3 V at both measured endpoints.

caption.zh: 复刻原卷插图，保留原图的视角、结构与标注。
caption.en: Recreated from the exam figure, preserving its perspective, geometry and labels.

concept.zh: 本题从分布参数模型出发，把无损线的传播性质与直流反弹图连接起来。
concept.en: This problem connects a distributed line model to lossless propagation and a DC bounce diagram.

known.zh: 模型给出 $l=0.3125\,\mathrm{\mu H/m}$、$c=55.6\,\mathrm{pF/m}$，电缆长度为 $60\,\mathrm m$；后半题的源与负载参数见电路图。
known.en: The model supplies $l=0.3125\,\mathrm{\mu H/m}$ and $c=55.6\,\mathrm{pF/m}$ for a $60\,\mathrm m$ cable. The later circuit supplies its source and load parameters.

goal.zh: 判断线是否有损，求速度因子、特性阻抗与延迟，再计算开关闭合后的反射和指定端点电压。
goal.en: Identify loss, find velocity factor, characteristic impedance and delay, then calculate reflections and the requested endpoint voltages after switching.

approach.zh: 先确认模型包含哪些储能或耗能元件，再求线参数。反弹分析使用这些参数作为输入，并把单个行波幅值与端点叠加电压区分开。
approach.en: First identify the storage and loss elements in the model, then calculate the line parameters. Use them in the bounce diagram, distinguishing individual wave amplitudes from summed endpoint voltages.

topic.zh: 驻波 · 功率 · 反射

statement.zh:
下方电路 A 中的传输线遭到损坏，导致其特性阻抗在沿线某处突变。

可将上方电路 A 中从损坏点到负载之间的传输线替换为一个有效输入阻抗 $Z_{\mathrm{eff}}$，得到下方电路 B 所示的模型。

利用定向耦合器，已确定电路 B 中输入端至 $Z_{\mathrm{eff}}$ 之间的稳态正向行波电压相量为 $\widetilde V^+(z)=5e^{-j2\pi z}\,\mathrm{V}$，反向行波电压相量为 $\widetilde V^-(z)=3e^{j2\pi z}\,\mathrm{V}$。
statement.en:
The transmission line in Circuit A below has been damaged, resulting in an abrupt change in its characteristic impedance at a point somewhere along the transmission line.

We can model Circuit A above by replacing the transmission line between the point of the damage and the load by an effective input impedance $Z_{\mathrm{eff}}$, as shown in Circuit B below.

Using a directional coupler, it has been determined that the steady-state forward-traveling voltage wave on the transmission line between its input and $Z_{\mathrm{eff}}$ in Circuit B is given by the phasor $\widetilde V^+(z)=5e^{-j2\pi z}\,\mathrm{V}$, and the backward-traveling voltage wave is given by the phasor $\widetilde V^-(z)=3e^{j2\pi z}\,\mathrm{V}$.

figureCaption.zh: 复刻原卷插图，保留原图的视角、结构与标注。
figureCaption.en: Recreated from the exam figure, preserving its perspective, geometry and labels.

prompt.zh: 写出输入端至 $Z_{\mathrm{eff}}$ 之间传输线上总电压波的时域表达式。
prompt.en: Write the expression for the total voltage wave on the transmission line between its input and $Z_{\mathrm{eff}}$ in the time domain.

text.zh: 先写相量取实部的定义，将正反行波相量先相加。
text.en: Begin with the real-part definition, adding forward and backward phasors first.

text.zh: 由原图的 150 MHz 频率求角频率，不把相位常数 2π 当成角频率。
text.en: Use the circuit frequency of 150 MHz to calculate angular frequency; do not confuse it with spatial phase constant 2π.

text.zh: 将给定的 5e⁻ʲ²πz 与 3eʲ²πz 两项完整代入。
text.en: Substitute both given terms 5e⁻ʲ²πz and 3eʲ²πz.

text.zh: 分别合并空间与时间指数，再用 Re(eʲθ)=cosθ。
text.en: Combine each spatial and temporal exponent, then use Re(eʲθ)=cosθ.

text.zh: 得到含一个正向、一个反向余弦行波的时域电压。
text.en: Obtain time-domain voltage as one forward and one backward cosine wave.

prompt.zh: 计算传输线与 $Z_{\mathrm{eff}}$ 之间的反射系数。
prompt.en: Calculate the reflection coefficient between the transmission line and $Z_{\mathrm{eff}}$.

text.zh: 先写原表的电压反射系数，必须比较同一参考面上的反向与正向波。
text.en: Begin with the crib voltage reflection coefficient, comparing backward and forward waves at the same reference plane.

text.zh: 按本题采用的 Zeff 参考面，两个给定行波系数分别为正实数 3 V 与 5 V。
text.en: At the Zeff reference plane used for this problem, the given wave coefficients are positive real 3 V and 5 V.

text.zh: 代入比值，电压单位约去，相位差为零。
text.en: Form the ratio; voltage units cancel and the phase difference is zero.

text.zh: 因此反射系数为正实数，而非只知道它的模。
text.en: The reflection coefficient is therefore positive real, rather than merely having a known magnitude.

prompt.zh: 计算驻波比。
prompt.en: Calculate the standing wave ratio.

text.zh: 先写原表的驻波比公式。
text.en: Begin with the crib standing-wave-ratio formula.

text.zh: 代入 |Γ|=0.6，分别计算分子、分母。
text.en: Substitute |Γ|=0.6 and evaluate numerator and denominator separately.

text.zh: 也可直接用最大最小包络交叉核对：两幅度相加为 8，相减为 2。
text.en: Cross-check with envelope extrema: the two amplitudes sum to 8 and differ by 2.

text.zh: 驻波比是无量纲量。
text.en: The standing-wave ratio is dimensionless.

prompt.zh: 计算传输线上的最大电压。该电压与电路 A 未损坏时传输线上的最大电压相比如何？简要解释。
prompt.en: Calculate the maximum voltage on the transmission line. How does this voltage compare with the maximum voltage on the transmission line when Circuit A is undamaged? Briefly explain.

text.zh: 先写原表中的电压包络最大值：正反行波在同相位置相加。
text.en: Begin with the crib maximum voltage envelope: the traveling waves add at constructive-interference positions.

text.zh: 将测得的两个峰值幅度代入，而不是把瞬时余弦值任意相加。
text.en: Insert the two measured peak amplitudes, rather than arbitrarily adding instantaneous cosine values.

text.zh: 可由复相量模的平方核对：驻波交叉项在 cos(4πz)=1 时最大。
text.en: Verify from the squared phasor magnitude: the standing-wave cross term is maximal when cos(4πz)=1.

text.zh: 未受损时负载匹配，Γ=0、反向幅度为零，最大包络仅为 5 V。
text.en: Before damage the load was matched, with Γ=0 and zero backward amplitude, giving only a 5 V maximum envelope.

text.zh: 损坏后最大电压增至原来的 1.6 倍。
text.en: After damage the maximum voltage is 1.6 times the undamaged value.

figureCaption.zh: 由原题 5 V 正向和 3 V 反向相量求得的驻波包络，最大值 8 V，最小值 2 V。
figureCaption.en: Standing-wave envelope computed from the stated 5 V forward and 3 V backward waves, with extrema 8 V and 2 V.

prompt.zh: 计算传递给 $Z_{\mathrm{eff}}$ 的时间平均功率。该功率与电路 A 未损坏时传递给负载的功率相比如何？简要解释。
prompt.en: Calculate the time-average power delivered to $Z_{\mathrm{eff}}$. How does this delivered power compare with the power delivered to the load when Circuit A is undamaged? Briefly explain.

text.zh: 先写原表的净平均功率式。题目电压相量是峰值幅度，所以分母含 2。
text.en: Begin with the crib net average-power equation. The voltage phasors are peak amplitudes, so the denominator includes two.

text.zh: 先算正向波功率，再算反射功率的大小。
text.en: Calculate forward power first and reflected-power magnitude separately.

text.zh: 反向功率朝源传播，因此送给 Zeff 的净功率是两者之差。
text.en: Reflected power travels toward the source, so net power delivered to Zeff is the difference.

text.zh: 同样代入 Γ 的公式可核对：1−0.6²=0.64，表示正向功率的 64% 被净接收。
text.en: Verify through Γ: 1−0.6²=0.64, so 64% of forward power is accepted as net power.

text.zh: 未受损时无反射，送达功率为 0.25 W，因此损坏后功率下降 36%。
text.en: Before damage there was no reflection and delivered power was 0.25 W, so damage reduces it by 36%.

prompt.zh: 计算阻抗 $Z_{\mathrm{eff}}$ 的值。传输线的损坏使该位置的特性阻抗增大还是减小？
prompt.en: Calculate the value of the impedance $Z_{\mathrm{eff}}$. Did the damage to the transmission line increase or decrease its characteristic impedance at that location?

text.zh: 先写反射系数与等效阻抗的原始关系。
text.en: Begin with the original relation between reflection coefficient and effective impedance.

text.zh: 先消分母，再把含 Zeff 的项移到同一侧。
text.en: Clear the denominator and collect terms containing Zeff.

text.zh: 提取 Zeff 并解出它，显示反射系数如何变成阻抗。
text.en: Factor out Zeff and solve, showing explicitly how reflection gives impedance.
Insert +0.6 and 50 Ω, first evaluating the dimensionless multiplier 1.6/0.4=4.

text.zh: 等效输入阻抗由 50 Ω 增至 200 Ω；这就是官方简化模型中“损坏使阻抗增大”的含义。
text.en: The effective input increases from 50 Ω to 200 Ω, which is the increase inferred in the official simplified model.

answerText.zh: 有效输入阻抗增大。仅由 Zeff 不能唯一还原损坏段本身的局部特性阻抗；原解在其简化模型下称为增大。
answerText.en: The effective input impedance increases. Zeff alone does not uniquely determine the damaged section’s local characteristic impedance; the official simplified model calls it an increase.

concept.zh: 本题从已测得的正、反向电压相量分析受损线上的驻波、功率和等效终端。
concept.en: This problem uses measured forward and backward voltage phasors to analyze standing waves, power and an effective termination.

known.zh: 两行波为 $\widetilde V^+=5e^{-j2\pi z}\,\mathrm V$ 与 $\widetilde V^-=3e^{j2\pi z}\,\mathrm V$，并给出 $Z_0=50\,\Omega$ 和工作频率。
known.en: The waves are $\widetilde V^+=5e^{-j2\pi z}\,\mathrm V$ and $\widetilde V^-=3e^{j2\pi z}\,\mathrm V$, with $Z_0=50\,\Omega$ and the operating frequency supplied.

goal.zh: 求时域电压、反射系数、驻波比、最大电压、净平均功率与等效阻抗，并与未损坏时比较。
goal.en: Find time-domain voltage, reflection coefficient, standing-wave ratio, maximum voltage, net average power and effective impedance, then compare with the undamaged line.

approach.zh: 先保留传播方向和相位约定，再从两行波的比值与叠加出发。功率要扣除反向波携带的功率，不能只把总电压幅值代入电阻功率式。
approach.en: Keep propagation direction and phase conventions explicit. Use the ratio and superposition of the waves, and subtract backward-wave power rather than treating total voltage magnitude as a resistor voltage.

topic.zh: 匹配性质 · 并联导纳

statement.zh:
对下列每一种情况：
1. 计算 $Z_{in}$。
2. 判断发生器电路所见的负载是否匹配。
使用传输线性质或阻抗匹配方法简要说明答案。仅依赖 $Z_{in}$ 通用数学公式的答案会被扣分。
statement.en:
In each of the cases below:
1. Calculate $Z_{in}$.
2. State whether or not the generator circuit sees a matched load.
Briefly justify your answer using a transmission line property or impedance matching method. Answers relying solely on the general mathematical equation for $Z_{in}$ will receive reduced credit.

prompt.zh: 发生器电路通过长度为 $L=\lambda/6$、特性阻抗为 $Z_0=50\Omega$ 的传输线连接到负载。
prompt.en: The generator circuit is connected to the load via a transmission line of length $L=\lambda/6$ and characteristic impedance $Z_0=50\Omega$.

text.zh: 优先使用匹配负载的性质，而不是只代通用输入阻抗式。先检验负载反射系数。
text.en: Use the matched-load property rather than only the general impedance formula. First check load reflection.

text.zh: 原图负载和线阻抗均为 50 Ω，因此 ΓL=0。
text.en: The original circuit has a 50 Ω load and 50 Ω line, so ΓL=0.

text.zh: 只有正向行波时，任意位置 V/I 均为 Z₀；所以 λ/6 长度也不改变输入阻抗。
text.en: With only a forward wave, V/I is Z₀ everywhere; a λ/6 length therefore leaves the input unchanged.

text.zh: 输入 50 Ω 等于源电阻，因此是匹配的。
text.en: The 50 Ω input equals source resistance and is matched.

text.zh: 先写原表的半波阻抗重复性质。
text.en: Begin with the crib half-wave impedance-repeat property.

text.zh: 半波长度对应 βL=π，一次往返相位为 2π，输入端与负载的电压电流比重复。
text.en: A half wavelength gives βL=π and round-trip phase 2π, repeating the load voltage/current ratio at the input.

text.zh: 把原图 25 Ω 负载代入，得到输入也是 25 Ω，虽然线本身的 Z₀ 为 50 Ω。
text.en: Substitute the original 25 Ω load to obtain a 25 Ω input, even though line Z₀ is 50 Ω.

text.zh: 比较的是源看到的整体输入与源电阻，故本电路匹配。
text.en: Compare the whole input seen by the source with source resistance; this circuit is matched.

prompt.en: The generator circuit is connected to the load via a transmission line of length $L=\lambda/4$ and characteristic impedance $Z_0=50\Omega$.

text.zh: 先写原表的四分之一波长阻抗反演性质。
text.en: Begin with the crib quarter-wave impedance inversion.

text.zh: 代入 Z₀=50 Ω、负载 100 Ω，保留平方的单位。
text.en: Substitute Z₀=50 Ω and load 100 Ω, retaining units in the square.

text.zh: 原图源电阻是 25 Ω，因此这段线正是匹配 25 Ω 与 100 Ω 的四分之一波变换线。
text.en: The circuit source is 25 Ω, so the line is exactly a quarter-wave transformer between 25 Ω and 100 Ω.
