prompt.zh:
发生器电路连接到特性阻抗为 $Z_0=50\Omega$ 的馈线。馈线与另外两根传输线的并联组合相连：
• 长度为 $d$、输入导纳为 $Y_d$、终端阻抗为 $Z_L$ 的传输线
• 长度为 $l$、输入导纳为 $Y_s$、终端开路的传输线
prompt.en:
The generator circuit is connected to a feedline of characteristic impedance $Z_0=50\Omega$. The feedline is connected to the parallel combination of two other transmission lines:
• a line of length $d$, input admittance $Y_d$, and terminating impedance $Z_L$
• a line of length $l$, input admittance $Y_s$, and an open-circuit termination

text.zh: 并联主线与支节共享电压，先由两支路电流相加推导导纳相加。
text.en: The parallel main line and stub share a voltage. Begin by adding branch currents to obtain admittance addition.

text.zh: 代入题给的两个有单位导纳，按实部和虚部分别相加。
text.en: Substitute both given admittances with units and add real and imaginary components separately.

text.zh: 主线感性电纳与开路支节电纳抵消，总导纳成为纯实数。
text.en: The main-line and open-stub susceptances cancel, leaving a purely real admittance.

text.zh: 导纳取倒数得到节点阻抗；西门子取倒数的单位为欧姆。
text.en: Invert admittance to obtain node impedance; reciprocal siemens are ohms.

text.zh: 节点与 50 Ω 馈线和源匹配；匹配馈线将这个阻抗重复到源。
text.en: The node matches the 50 Ω feedline and source; the matched feedline repeats that impedance to the source.

caption.zh: 复刻原卷插图，保留原图的视角、结构与标注。
caption.en: Recreated from the exam figure, preserving its perspective, geometry and labels.

concept.zh: 本题考查能否识别传输线的特殊性质，而不是直接套用通用输入阻抗公式。
concept.en: This problem tests recognition of line properties rather than substitution into the general input-impedance formula.

known.zh: 各电路给出终端、发生器电阻与线长，包括 $\lambda/6$、$\lambda/2$、$\lambda/4$ 及并联开路支节；线的特性阻抗为 $50\,\Omega$。
known.en: The diagrams supply terminations, source resistances and lengths including $\lambda/6$, $\lambda/2$, $\lambda/4$ and a parallel open stub. The characteristic impedance is $50\,\Omega$.

goal.zh: 分别求发生器看到的输入阻抗，并据此判断源端是否匹配。
goal.en: Find the impedance seen by the generator in each circuit and decide whether the source is matched.

approach.zh: 先检查终端是否已匹配，再识别半波重复与四分之一波变换。并联支节应先合成导纳，最后才将总输入阻抗与发生器电阻比较。
approach.en: Check for a matched termination, then recognize half-wave repetition and quarter-wave transformation. Combine a parallel stub in admittance before comparing the resulting input impedance with the source resistance.

title.zh: 利用 Smith 图的阻抗匹配
title.en: Impedance Matching with a Smith Chart

topic.zh: Smith 图 · 复数负载匹配

statement.zh: 下方电路的负载需要通过特性阻抗为 $Z_{0T}$ 的四分之一波长变换器，以及一段长度为 $d$、特性阻抗为 $Z_0$ 的传输线，匹配到 $Z_0=50\Omega$ 的馈线。长度为 $d$ 的传输线速度因子为 $0.85$，线上信号的频率为 $f=100\,\mathrm{MHz}=100\times10^6\,\mathrm{Hz}$。
statement.en: The load in the circuit below is to be matched to a $Z_0=50\Omega$ feedline using a quarter-wave transformer of characteristic impedance $Z_{0T}$ and a length of transmission line $d$ of characteristic impedance $Z_0$. The velocity factor of the transmission line of length $d$ is $0.85$ and the frequency of the signal on the line is $f=100\,\mathrm{MHz}=100\times10^6\,\mathrm{Hz}$.

figureCaption.zh: 复刻原卷插图，保留原图的视角、结构与标注。
figureCaption.en: Recreated from the exam figure, preserving its perspective, geometry and labels.

label.en: Through-line rotation on a Smith chart

label.zh: 主线加四分之一波匹配

prompt.zh: 计算归一化负载阻抗，并在 Smith 图上标出。
prompt.en: Calculate the normalized load impedance. Plot it on the Smith chart.

text.zh: 先写归一化负载阻抗定义，参考阻抗为题设 50 Ω。
text.en: Begin with normalized load impedance referenced to the specified 50 Ω.

text.zh: 把实部 150 Ω 与虚部 −j50 Ω 分别除以 50 Ω。
text.en: Divide the real 150 Ω and imaginary −j50 Ω parts separately by 50 Ω.

text.zh: 在 Smith 图上找 r=3 圆与 x=−1 弧的交点；负电抗位于下半图。
text.en: On the Smith chart intersect r=3 with x=−1; negative reactance lies in the lower half.

text.zh: 用共轭数求反射系数坐标，后续实轴交点和旋转都沿同一个等模圆。
text.en: Use the conjugate to obtain the reflection-plane coordinate; subsequent real-axis intersections and rotations follow its magnitude circle.

text.zh: 标出的归一化负载阻抗如下。
text.en: The plotted normalized load impedance is:

prompt.zh: 长度为 $d$ 的传输线能够呈现的两种纯实数输入阻抗 $Z_{in,d}$ 是多少？在 Smith 图上展示过程。给出未归一化的阻抗。
prompt.en: What are the two values of purely real input impedance $Z_{in,d}$ that the transmission line of length $d$ could present? Show your work on the Smith chart. Give your impedances in unnormalized format.

text.zh: 先由反射系数反解归一化阻抗。纯实输入阻抗对应 Smith 图实轴上的 Γ。
text.en: Invert the reflection equation for normalized impedance. Purely real input impedance corresponds to real-axis Γ on the Smith chart.

text.zh: 无损线向源移动只改变相位，不改变 Γ 的模；先由负载值求该圆的半径。
text.en: Moving toward the source on a lossless line changes phase but not magnitude. Calculate the circle radius from the load.

text.zh: 实轴上的两个交点为 +ρ 与 −ρ；分别代入阻抗反解式。
text.en: The two real-axis intersections are +ρ and −ρ. Substitute both into the impedance relation.

text.zh: 代入半径，得到两个无量纲电阻值，互为倒数。
text.en: Insert the radius to obtain reciprocal dimensionless resistances.

text.zh: 题目要求去归一化，分别乘回 50 Ω，而不是直接把图上刻度当欧姆。
text.en: The question asks for unnormalized values, so multiply each chart reading by 50 Ω.

text.zh: 结果由给定复负载精确计算；官方图上的近似读数保留在核对说明中。
text.en: These values are computed from the exact stated load; the official chart estimates remain documented in the source note.

note.zh: 官方图读数约 14.5 Ω 与 170 Ω，且把“0.26×50”写成 14.5；该乘法本身不一致。本页由原负载精确计算，图上近似读数作为参考。
note.en: The official chart reads about 14.5 Ω and 170 Ω and writes “0.26×50=14.5”, an inconsistent multiplication. Here the values are computed exactly from the given load.

prompt.zh: 从第 b) 问的两个 $Z_{in,d}$ 中任选一个。传输线长度 $d$ 应为多少米，才能呈现所选的输入阻抗 $Z_{in,d}$？在 Smith 图上展示过程。
prompt.en: Choose one of the two values of $Z_{in,d}$ from part b). How long $d$ (in meters) must the transmission line be to present your chosen input impedance $Z_{in,d}$? Show your work on the Smith chart.

text.zh: 先写波长与反射系数沿线传播关系；向源移动 d 使 Γ 顺时针旋转 4πd/λ。
text.en: Begin with wavelength and reflection propagation. Moving d toward the source rotates Γ clockwise by 4πd/λ.

text.zh: 代入速度因子和频率，求出将电长度换成米所需的波长。
text.en: Substitute velocity factor and frequency for the wavelength needed to convert electrical length to meters.

text.zh: 由 ΓL=(9−2j)/17 求初始相位，使用弧度制。
text.en: Find the initial phase from ΓL=(9−2j)/17, in radians.

text.zh: 若选较小实电阻，目标是 Γ=−ρ，即相位 −π。列出旋转角方程并解 d。
text.en: For the smaller real resistance target Γ=−ρ, with phase −π. Write the rotation equation and solve for d.

text.zh: 将第一分支电长度乘波长；另一实轴交点比它多转半圈，对应再加 λ/4。
text.en: Multiply the first electrical length by λ. Reaching the other real-axis intersection requires another half-turn, adding λ/4.

text.zh: 第二分支也换成米。两个方案均可，后续变换线阻抗必须与所选分支配套。
text.en: Convert the second branch to meters as well. Either works, but the subsequent transformer impedance must use the matching branch.

text.zh: 列出两组电阻与长度的对应关系。
text.en: State the resistance–length pairing for both branches.

figureCaption.zh: 从复负载沿等反射系数模圆顺时针旋转，到达两个实轴交点。
figureCaption.en: Clockwise rotation from the complex load along its constant-reflection-magnitude circle to both real-axis intersections.

prompt.zh: 对第 c) 问选取的情况，求将负载网络匹配到 $Z_0=50\Omega$ 馈线所需的四分之一波长变换器特性阻抗 $Z_{0T}$。
prompt.en: For the case you chose in part c), find the characteristic impedance $Z_{0T}$ of the quarter-wave transformer that matches the load network to the $Z_0=50\Omega$ feedline.

text.zh: 先写原表四分之一波长变换公式；变换线的负载是前段线路呈现的纯电阻。
text.en: Begin with the crib quarter-wave equation; the transformer load is the real input resistance presented by the preceding line.

text.zh: 要求变换线向馈线呈现 50 Ω，先移项得到平方根公式。
text.en: Require a 50 Ω input to the feedline and rearrange to obtain the square-root formula.

text.zh: 若 c) 选择较小电阻分支，代入 14.8371295 Ω。
text.en: For the smaller-resistance branch in c), insert 14.8371295 Ω.

text.zh: 若选择较大电阻分支，必须相应改用 168.4962038 Ω。
text.en: For the larger-resistance branch, use its corresponding 168.4962038 Ω.

text.zh: 任选一组即可；将 Z₀T² 除以对应电阻会恢复 50 Ω，验证馈线匹配。
text.en: Either branch works. Dividing Z₀T² by its corresponding resistance returns 50 Ω and verifies the feedline match.

prompt.zh:
传输线和负载与馈线匹配后，发生器会在稳态下向负载传输最大功率。系统中哪些位置仍会发生反射？圈出所有适用项。

a. 馈线与 $L=\lambda/4$ 传输线输入端的界面。
b. $L=\lambda/4$ 传输线与长度为 $d$ 的传输线输入端的界面。
c. 长度为 $d$ 的传输线与负载 $Z_L$ 的界面。
d. 由于馈线已与负载匹配，系统任何位置都不会发生反射。
prompt.en:
Once the transmission line and load are matched to the feedline, maximum power will be transferred from the generator to the load in steady state. Where do reflections still occur in the system?
Circle all that apply.

a. At the interface between the feedline and the input to the $L=\lambda/4$ line.
b. At the interface between the $L=\lambda/4$ line and the input to the line of length $d$.
c. At the interface between the line of length $d$ and the load $Z_L$.
d. No reflections occur anywhere in the system since the feedline is matched to the load.

text.zh: 先写局部界面反射公式。这里比较界面两侧的行波特性阻抗；它与整个网络的净输入反射不是同一量。
text.en: Begin with local interface reflection. Compare traveling-wave characteristic impedances on the two sides; this differs from the net input reflection of the whole network.

text.zh: 选项 a：50 Ω 馈线接到 Z₀T 的变换线，两侧特性阻抗不同，因此存在局部反射。
text.en: Option a: the 50 Ω feedline meets the Z₀T transformer. The different characteristic impedances give a local reflection.

text.zh: 选项 b：变换线接回 50 Ω 主线，阻抗差也非零。
text.en: Option b: the transformer meets the 50 Ω main line, again with a nonzero impedance step.

text.zh: 选项 c：主线接到 150−j50 Ω 的复负载，也仍然存在负载反射。
text.en: Option c: the main line meets the complex load 150−j50 Ω and still has load reflection.

text.zh: 整体匹配表示多次反射返回馈线的相量恰好抵消，使净输入反射为零；不能据此删掉 a 的局部反射。
text.en: Overall matching means the multiple reflected phasors returning into the feedline cancel, giving zero net input reflection; it does not remove the local reflection at a.

text.zh: 所以按标准答案的“哪些界面有反射”问法，选 a、b、c，选项 d 不成立。
text.en: Thus, for the official question about interfaces with reflections, select a, b and c; option d is false.

answerText.zh: 选 a、b、c。三个阻抗突变处都有局部反射；整体匹配使这些返回馈线的反射相量抵消，净输入反射为零。
answerText.en: Select a, b and c. Each impedance discontinuity has a local reflection; overall matching cancels the returning reflected phasors at the feedline, giving zero net input reflection.

concept.zh: 本题考查先用主线消去复负载的虚部，再用四分之一波长变换器完成匹配。
concept.en: This problem first transforms a complex load to a real impedance, then completes the match with a quarter-wave transformer.

known.zh: $Z_L=(150-j50)\,\Omega$、$Z_0=50\,\Omega$，长度为 $d$ 的线速度因子为 $0.85$，工作频率为 $100\,\mathrm{MHz}$。
known.en: The load is $Z_L=(150-j50)\,\Omega$ and the feedline is $50\,\Omega$. The section of length $d$ has velocity factor $0.85$ at $100\,\mathrm{MHz}$.

goal.zh: 在 Smith 图上找出两种纯实输入阻抗，选一支求实际线长与变换器阻抗，并判断系统内部哪些界面仍有反射。
goal.en: Find the two real input impedances on the Smith chart, choose a branch for physical length and transformer impedance, and identify interfaces where reflections remain.

approach.zh: 先沿负载的等反射系数圆找到实轴交点，再把图上的波长读数换成米。四分之一波变换器负责第二次阻抗变换；馈线匹配并不等于内部每个界面都匹配。
approach.en: Find the real-axis crossings on the load's constant-reflection circle and convert wavelength readings to meters. The quarter-wave section performs the second transformation; a matched feedline does not imply that every internal interface is matched.

title.zh: 球对称情况下的高斯定律

topic.zh: 高斯定律

statement.zh:
本题将使用高斯定律，求各区域的电场。

下方系统由以下部分组成：
• 半径为 $a$、具有恒定体电荷密度 $\rho_0$ 的球体。
• 半径为 $b$、面电荷密度为 $\rho_{sb}$ 的导体壳。

导体壳的总电荷与球内总电荷大小相等、符号相反。区域 $a<r<b$ 中没有自由电荷 $\rho$，其介电常数为 $\varepsilon_0$。

注意：所有图都必须包含解题所用高斯面的形状和位置。
statement.en:
In this problem, you will use Gauss’s law to solve for the electric field in each region.

The system below consists of:
• A sphere of constant volumetric charge density $\rho_0$ and radius $a$.
• A conducting shell of radius $b$ and surface charge density $\rho_{sb}$.

The total charge on the conducting shell is equal in magnitude to the total charge contained in the sphere, but opposite in sign. The region $a<r<b$ contains no free charge $\rho$ and the permittivity is $\varepsilon_0$.

Note: All diagrams must include the shape and position of the Gaussian surface used in your solution.

figureCaption.zh: 复刻原卷插图，保留原图的视角、结构与标注。
figureCaption.en: Recreated from the exam figure, preserving its perspective, geometry and labels.

prompt.zh: 画出用于求区域 $0<r<a$ 内电场的示意图。
prompt.en: Draw the diagram you will use for finding the electric field in the region $0<r<a$.

text.zh: 先写公式表中的高斯定律：闭合面的电位移通量等于面内自由电荷。
text.en: Begin with the crib equation: displacement flux through a closed surface equals its enclosed free charge.

text.zh: 球对称使电场沿径向；同一半径上的场强相同。这里用 R 表示固定的高斯面半径，避免和积分变量混淆。
text.en: Spherical symmetry makes the field radial and constant at a fixed radius. Use R for the fixed Gaussian radius, distinct from integration coordinates.

text.zh: 先画半径 a 的带电实心球和半径 b 的导体薄壳，再在实心球内画与二者同心的虚线球面。
text.en: Draw the charged solid sphere of radius a and the conducting shell of radius b, then a concentric dashed Gaussian sphere inside the solid sphere.

text.zh: 在同一个球心上标出 a、b、R 三根半径箭头；R 箭头必须止于虚线面，法向从该面向外。
text.en: Start all three radius arrows a, b and R at the same center. End R on the dashed surface and draw its outward normal from that surface.

text.zh: 该闭合面只包围半径 R 内的体电荷；a 与 b 是材料边界，不是此问选取的高斯面。
text.en: The closed surface encloses only the volume charge within R. The radii a and b are material boundaries, not the chosen Gaussian surface.

figureCaption.zh: 同心球截面，虚线表示半径 0<R<a 的闭合高斯球面；半径 a、b、R 共享球心。
figureCaption.en: Concentric-sphere section with the closed Gaussian sphere at 0<R<a; radii a, b and R share one center.

note.zh: 原解的高斯面草图在内球附近标了 ρsa，但题干给定的是均匀体电荷密度 ρ₀。本图按题干使用 ρ₀；虚线圆是三维闭合高斯球面的截面，R 为其半径。a、b、R 都从同一球心量起。
note.en: The official Gaussian-surface sketches label the inner sphere with ρsa, but the prompt specifies uniform volume density ρ₀. These diagrams use ρ₀ from the prompt. The dashed circle is a section of a closed spherical Gaussian surface of radius R; a, b and R share one center.

prompt.zh: 求区域 $0<r<a$ 内的电场。
prompt.en: Find the electric field in the region $0<r<a$.

text.zh: 从原始高斯定律开始，并用本构关系把 D 换成电场。
text.en: Start from Gauss’s law and substitute the constitutive relation for D.

text.zh: 在半径固定为 R 的球面上代入径向场和球坐标面积元，先保留点积。
text.en: On the sphere of fixed radius R, substitute the radial field and spherical area element, retaining the dot product.

text.zh: 两个单位法向的点积为 1；场强不随角度变化，可移到积分号外。
text.en: The unit normals have dot product one. The field is angle independent, so take it outside the integrals.

text.zh: 分别求两个角积分，不能直接省略球面积的来源。
text.en: Evaluate both angular integrals explicitly to obtain the spherical area factor.

text.zh: 另算包围电荷：密度为常数，径向积分从 0 到高斯半径 R。用 r′ 作为体积分变量。
text.en: Compute enclosed charge separately. Density is constant and the radial limit is R; use r′ as the volume integration variable.

text.zh: 将三个积分相乘，逐项求值。外面的薄壳没有被这个高斯面包围。
text.en: Evaluate the three factors. The outer conducting shell is not enclosed by this surface.

text.zh: 令通量等于包围电荷，两边除以 4πε₀R²；R³/R² 留下 R。
text.en: Equate flux and enclosed charge, then divide by 4πε₀R²; R³/R² leaves R.

text.zh: 最后把任意高斯半径 R 改记为观察半径 r，并补回径向单位矢量。
text.en: Relabel the arbitrary Gaussian radius R as the observation radius r and restore the radial unit vector.

prompt.zh: 画出用于求区域 $a\le r\le b$ 内电场的示意图。
prompt.en: Draw the diagram you will use for finding the electric field in the region $a\le r\le b$.

text.zh: 仍从闭合面高斯定律出发，球对称要求使用同心球面。
text.en: Again use Gauss’s law on a closed surface; spherical symmetry suggests a concentric sphere.

text.zh: 将虚线高斯面画在半径 a 的实心球之外、半径 b 的导体薄壳之内。
text.en: Place the dashed Gaussian sphere outside the solid sphere of radius a and inside the shell of radius b.

text.zh: a、b、R 都从同一个球心量起。高斯面包围整个带电实心球，但不包围外壳电荷。
text.en: Measure a, b and R from the same center. The Gaussian sphere encloses the whole charged solid sphere but excludes the shell charge.

text.zh: 在高斯面上标出向外法向。原题含等号时，b 处的场须取介质一侧 b⁻ 的极限。
text.en: Mark the outward surface normal. At the printed endpoint b, the dielectric-region field means the one-sided limit b⁻.

text.zh: 图中虚线球面的半径满足下式，后续积分在这一个固定半径上进行。
text.en: The dashed spherical surface has the following radius range; the subsequent flux integral uses this fixed radius.

figureCaption.zh: 同心球截面，高斯球面位于 a<R<b，只包围内球体电荷；虚线为高斯面截线。
figureCaption.en: Concentric-sphere section with a<R<b; the dashed Gaussian surface encloses only the solid-sphere volume charge.

prompt.zh: 求区域 $a\le r\le b$ 内的电场。
prompt.en: Find the electric field in the region $a\le r\le b$.

text.zh: 先写高斯定律及 D 与 E 的关系，取 a<R<b 的同心球面。
text.en: Write Gauss’s law and the D–E relation on a concentric sphere with a<R<b.

text.zh: 代入球面面积元并计算点积；同心球面上的场强为常数。
text.en: Substitute the spherical area element and evaluate the dot product; field magnitude is constant over the sphere.

text.zh: 展开角积分，得到通量系数。
text.en: Evaluate the angular factors to obtain the flux coefficient.

text.zh: 体电荷只存在于 0≤r′≤a。即使高斯半径为 R，电荷积分上限仍是 a。
text.en: Volume charge exists only for 0≤r′≤a. The charge integral ends at a even though the Gaussian radius is R.

text.zh: 径向积分为 a³/3，角积分乘出 4π；a 到 R 的无电荷区不增加包围电荷。
text.en: The radial integral gives a³/3 and the angular integrals give 4π. The charge-free region from a to R adds no enclosed charge.

text.zh: 把右侧电荷代入高斯定律，并除以通量系数求出径向场。
text.en: Substitute the enclosed charge into Gauss’s law and divide by the flux coefficient.

text.zh: 改用观察坐标 r 表示结果。r=a 时与内区结果连续；r=b 表示 b⁻。
text.en: Express the result using observation radius r. It is continuous with the inner result at a; the endpoint b means b⁻.

prompt.zh: 画出用于求区域 $r>b$ 内电场的示意图。
prompt.en: Draw the diagram you will use for finding the electric field in the region $r>b$.

text.zh: 先写闭合面的高斯定律；所选面现在必须包住实心球和导体薄壳。
text.en: Begin with Gauss’s law; the chosen closed surface must now enclose both the solid sphere and conducting shell.

text.zh: 以同一球心画半径 R>b 的虚线球面，并从球心画出 R 箭头至虚线面。
text.en: Draw a concentric dashed sphere with R>b and a radius arrow from the common center to that dashed surface.

text.zh: 分别标明 a 内的体电荷和 b 上的表面电荷；外面的虚线才是高斯面。
text.en: Distinguish the volume charge within a, the surface charge at b and the outer dashed Gaussian surface.

text.zh: 面法向仍向外。零场结论来自下一问的电荷相消，而不是改变高斯面形状。
text.en: The surface normal remains outward. The zero field follows from charge cancellation in the next part, not from changing the surface geometry.

figureCaption.zh: 同心球截面，高斯球面位于 R>b，同时包围等量异号的内球与外壳电荷。
figureCaption.en: Concentric-sphere section with R>b; the Gaussian surface encloses the equal and opposite sphere and shell charges.

prompt.zh: 求区域 $r>b$ 内的电场。
prompt.en: Find the electric field in the region $r>b$.

text.zh: 在壳外同心球面应用高斯定律，并代入真空本构关系。
text.en: Apply Gauss’s law outside the shell and substitute the vacuum constitutive relation.

text.zh: 球对称使通量积分化为球面积乘径向电位移。
text.en: Spherical symmetry reduces the flux to spherical area times radial displacement.

text.zh: 将内球体电荷与外壳等量异号的电荷分别写出，再相加。
text.en: Write the solid-sphere charge and the equal, opposite shell charge separately before adding them.

text.zh: 代入定律并除以非零的 4πε₀R²。由球对称性，零总通量在这里推出场本身为零。
text.en: Substitute and divide by nonzero 4πε₀R². With spherical symmetry, zero flux here implies zero field itself.

text.zh: 恢复矢量形式并注明适用区域。
text.en: Restore vector notation and state the domain.

prompt.zh: 若将区域 $a<r<b$ 中的材料替换为介电常数满足 $\varepsilon>\varepsilon_0$ 的电介质，$r=b$ 与 $r=a$ 之间的电势差会怎样变化？结合电介质材料和极化解释这一变化。
prompt.en: If you were to replace the material in the region $a<r<b$ by a dielectric with $\varepsilon>\varepsilon_0$, how would this affect the potential difference between $r=b$ and $r=a$? Explain this change in the context of electric materials and polarization.

text.zh: 比较电势差前，先写原表的电势积分及本构关系。
text.en: Before comparing potentials, write the crib potential integral and constitutive relation.

steps.math: V(b)-V(a)=-\int_a^b\mathbf E\cdot d\mathbf l,\qquad\mathbf D=\epsilon\mathbf E

text.zh: 更换介质时保持题设自由电荷不变，因此同一高斯面上的 D 仍由同一个包围电荷确定。
text.en: Replacing the dielectric leaves the specified free charges fixed, so D on a given Gaussian surface is set by the same enclosed charge.

text.zh: 分别除以新旧介电常数得到两个电场；不能把 D 和 E 同时按相同比例缩小。
text.en: Divide by the new and old permittivities to obtain the fields; D does not decrease along with E.

text.zh: 沿径向从 a 到 b 积分。若用 V(a)−V(b)，电势积分外侧负号相应反转。
text.en: Integrate radially from a to b. For V(a)−V(b), reverse the leading sign accordingly.

text.zh: 写出原函数并代入上下限。
text.en: Write the antiderivative and evaluate both limits.

text.zh: 诱导偶极的极化响应减小同一自由电荷产生的电场。取绝对值比较，结论不依赖 ρ₀ 的符号。
text.en: The induced-dipole polarization response reduces the field for the same free charge. Compare magnitudes so the conclusion is independent of the sign of ρ₀.

note.zh: 场在导体薄壳处有跳变：a≤r≤b 的公式应理解为介质内极限，不能把介质中的场值当成导体内的场。
note.en: The field jumps at the conducting shell. Interpret the a≤r≤b expression as a dielectric-side limit, not the field inside the conductor.

concept.zh: 本题考查球对称高斯定律，以及改变介质后电场与电势差的变化。
concept.en: This problem uses spherical symmetry in Gauss's law and examines how dielectric material changes field and potential difference.

known.zh: 半径 $a$ 的球有均匀体电荷密度 $\rho_0$；半径 $b$ 的导体壳带等量异号总电荷，初始夹层介电常数为 $\varepsilon_0$。
known.en: A sphere of radius $a$ has uniform charge density $\rho_0$. The conducting shell at radius $b$ carries the opposite total charge; the gap initially has permittivity $\varepsilon_0$.

goal.zh: 为三个径向区域分别选取高斯面并求电场，再解释填入更高介电常数材料后电势差如何变化。
goal.en: Choose Gaussian surfaces and find the field in three radial regions, then explain the change in potential difference for a higher-permittivity dielectric.

approach.zh: 先按观察半径列出实际包围的电荷，再利用球面对称性简化通量。导体壳与球的总电荷相消，只能直接用于同时包围二者的高斯面。
approach.en: Determine the enclosed charge separately for each observation radius, then use spherical symmetry to simplify flux. Cancellation of the two total charges applies directly only to a surface enclosing both.

title.zh: 含两种电介质的平行板电容器
title.en: Parallel Plate Capacitor with Two Dielectrics

topic.zh: 边界条件 · 电场能量

statement.zh:
下方系统中，位于 $x=0$ 和 $x=L$ 的两块导体板之间填充了两种不同的电介质：
• 区域 1 占据 $\frac{H}{2}<z\le H$，其介电常数为 $\varepsilon_1$。
• 区域 2 占据 $0\le z<H/2$，其介电常数为 $\varepsilon_2$。

位于 $x=0$ 的板保持恒定电势 $V_0$，位于 $x=L$ 的板保持恒定电势 $V_1$。板在 z 方向的高度为 $H$，在 y 方向的深度为 $W$。
区域 1 的电场给定为 $\vec E_1(x)=\frac{V_1-V_0}{L}\hat x$。
statement.en:
In the system below, the space between two conducting plates located at $x=0$ and $x=L$ is filled with two different dielectrics:
• Region 1 occupies the space $\frac{H}{2}<z\le H$ and has permittivity $\varepsilon_1$.
• Region 2 occupies the space $0\le z<H/2$ and has permittivity $\varepsilon_2$.

The plate at $x=0$ is held at a constant potential $V_0$, while the plate at $x=L$ is held at a constant potential $V_1$. The plates have height $H$ in the z-dimension and depth $W$ in the y-direction.
The electric field in region 1 is given by $\vec E_1(x)=\frac{V_1-V_0}{L}\hat x$.

figureCaption.zh: 复刻原卷插图，保留原图的视角、结构与标注。
figureCaption.en: Recreated from the exam figure, preserving its perspective, geometry and labels.

prompt.zh: 求区域 2 内的电场 $\vec E_2(x)$ 和电位移场 $\vec D_2(x)$。忽略边缘效应。
prompt.en: Find the electric field, $\vec E_2(x)$, and displacement field, $\vec D_2(x)$, in region 2. Ignore fringing effects.

text.zh: 先写切向电场连续条件及本构关系。介质分界面法向为 z，题中的电场沿 x，属于切向分量。
text.en: Write tangential-field continuity and the constitutive relation. The dielectric interface normal is z, so the x-directed field is tangential.

text.zh: 用给定的两块等势板求电位函数：无边缘效应时电位随 x 线性变化。
text.en: Find the potential from the stated plate potentials: without fringing it varies linearly with x.

text.zh: 按 E=−∇V 求导。题面与官方答案给出的正号和板电位矛盾，下面使用与板电位一致的方向。
text.en: Differentiate using E=−∇V. The printed positive sign conflicts with the plate potentials; use the direction consistent with those potentials.

text.zh: 切向连续给出 E₂=E₁；再将它代入 D₂=ε₂E₂，法向分量均为零。
text.en: Tangential continuity gives E₂=E₁. Substitute this into D₂=ε₂E₂; both normal components are zero.

text.zh: 组合为所求两个矢量。若沿用试卷印出的场方向，E 和 D 的符号一起反转，后面的能量不变。
text.en: Assemble the requested vectors. Following the printed field instead reverses both E and D; the later energy is unchanged.

note.zh: 原题与官方解把 E 写成 +(V₁−V₀)/L，与所给边界电位及 E=−∇V 不一致。这里采用物理一致的负号；若按题面给定场作答，D 同时反号，后续能量和电容不受影响。
note.en: The prompt and official solution print +(V₁−V₀)/L, inconsistent with the stated potentials and E=−∇V. This version uses the consistent minus sign. Taking the printed field instead also reverses D; energy and capacitance remain unchanged.

prompt.zh: 利用第 a) 问的结果，求导体板之间区域储存的总电能。
prompt.en: Using your results from part a), find the total electric energy stored in the region between the conducting plates.

text.zh: 先写电场能量的体积分原式；两种介质须分别积分后相加。
text.en: Begin with the field-energy volume integral; integrate each dielectric separately and then add.

text.zh: 两区域的场强大小相同，平方后电场方向或题面符号差异不会影响能量。
text.en: The field magnitudes agree in both regions. Squaring removes dependence on field direction or the printed sign.

text.zh: 区域 1 的三个积分范围分别为 x 从 0 到 L、y 从 0 到 W、z 从 H/2 到 H。
text.en: For region 1, integrate x from 0 to L, y from 0 to W and z from H/2 to H.

text.zh: 被积函数为常数，三个积分给出 L、W、H/2。
text.en: The integrand is constant; the three integrals give L, W and H/2.

text.zh: 区域 2 只改变介电常数和 z 的积分范围；同样得到一半板间体积。
text.en: Region 2 changes only the permittivity and z bounds; its volume is the other half of the gap.

text.zh: 提取两项的公因子并相加。
text.en: Factor the common terms and add both contributions.

prompt.zh: 使用总储存电能法求该系统的电容。
prompt.en: Find the capacitance of the system using the total stored electric energy method.

text.zh: 原表给出电容器储能与电压的关系，这里的电压是两板电势差。
text.en: Use the crib capacitor-energy relation, with voltage equal to the plate potential difference.

text.zh: 将上问求出的总能量完整代入，而不是直接使用平行板电容结论。
text.en: Substitute the full energy found above rather than jumping to a parallel-plate capacitance formula.

text.zh: 两边乘 2 并约去电势差的平方；零电压的情形由同一线性电容关系延续得到。
text.en: Multiply by two and cancel the squared potential difference. The zero-voltage case follows from the same linear capacitance relation.

text.zh: 化简系数，并检查量纲为 F。
text.en: Simplify the coefficient and check that the dimension is farads.

prompt.zh: 附加题：第 c) 问的结果是否符合电路理论中并联电容的组合方式？解释。
prompt.en: Bonus: Does your result in part c) agree with how parallel capacitances combine according to circuit theory? Explain.

text.zh: 从电容定义出发；并联等效的条件是两个区域连接同一对等势板。
text.en: Begin with the definition of capacitance. The two regions share the same pair of equipotential plates, so they have the same voltage.

text.zh: 两区域各占 H/2 的高度，面积均为 HW/2；场方向上的板间距都是 L。
text.en: Each region occupies half the height, so each area is HW/2 and both field-direction gaps are L.

text.zh: 同一板上的两部分电荷相加，把 Qᵢ=CᵢΔV 逐项代入。
text.en: Add the two charge contributions on a plate and substitute Qᵢ=CᵢΔV.

text.zh: 除以共同电压，即得到与能量法相同的并联结果。
text.en: Divide by the common voltage to recover the same parallel result as the energy method.

answerText.zh: 是，两区域等效并联。Bonus 不计入试卷标称 42 分。
answerText.en: Yes: the regions are in parallel. The bonus is excluded from the exam’s stated 42 points.

concept.zh: 本题考查介质边界条件和电场能量法，并用电路中的并联电容作核对。
concept.en: This problem combines dielectric boundary conditions with field-energy capacitance and a parallel-capacitor check.

known.zh: 两极板间距为 $L$，电势分别为 $V_0$、$V_1$；两种介质沿高度各占一半，介电常数为 $\varepsilon_1$、$\varepsilon_2$，共同承受两板间电压。
known.en: The plates are separated by $L$ at potentials $V_0$ and $V_1$. Two dielectrics of permittivities $\varepsilon_1$ and $\varepsilon_2$ each occupy half the height and share the plate voltage.

goal.zh: 求第二种介质中的电场与电位移、总储能和电容，再判断是否符合并联电容规则。
goal.en: Find the field and displacement in the second dielectric, total stored energy and capacitance, then compare with the parallel-capacitor rule.

approach.zh: 先看清电场相对介质界面的方向，选择切向边界条件。分别对两块介质积分能量后相加；电场方向的符号还要与极板电势核对。
approach.en: Identify the field direction relative to the dielectric interface and use the tangential boundary condition. Integrate energy over each dielectric and add the results, checking the field's sign against the plate potentials.

topic.zh: 拉普拉斯方程 · 电容

statement.zh: 下方同轴电缆由一个半径为 $a$ 的接地内导体，以及一个半径为 $b$、保持恒定电势 $-V_0$ 的外导体壳组成。导体之间的区域 $a<r<b$ 没有自由电荷，并填充了介电常数为 $\varepsilon$ 的电介质。
statement.en: The coaxial cable below consists of a grounded, inner conductor of radius $a$ and an outer conducting shell of radius $b$, which is held at a constant potential $-V_0$. The space between the conductors $a<r<b$ has no free charge and is filled by a dielectric with permittivity $\varepsilon$.

figureCaption.zh: 复刻原卷插图，保留原图的视角、结构与标注。
figureCaption.en: Recreated from the exam figure, preserving its perspective, geometry and labels.

prompt.zh: 使用 Laplace 方程或 Poisson 方程，求区域 $a\le r\le b$ 内的 $V(\vec r)$。
prompt.en: Use Laplace’s or Poisson’s equation to find $V(\vec r)$ in the region $a\le r\le b$.

text.zh: 先写原表的 Laplace 方程。介质中没有自由体电荷，所以 Poisson 方程的右侧为零。
text.en: Begin with the crib Laplace equation. With no free volume charge, the right side of Poisson’s equation vanishes.

text.zh: 忽略端部效应，柱对称使电位只依赖 r，φ 与 z 的导数项都为零。
text.en: Neglecting end effects, cylindrical symmetry makes V depend only on r; the φ and z derivative terms vanish.

text.zh: 乘以 r 并积分一次，把第一个积分常数记为 A。
text.en: Multiply by r and integrate once, calling the first constant A.

text.zh: 除以 r 再积分一次；用无量纲 r/a 写对数，第二个常数记为 B。
text.en: Divide by r and integrate again. Use dimensionless r/a in the logarithm and call the second constant B.

text.zh: 先代入内导体接地边界，解出 B。
text.en: Apply the grounded inner-conductor boundary first to determine B.

text.zh: 再代入外导体电位，解出 A。
text.en: Apply the outer-conductor potential next to determine A.

text.zh: 把两个常数代回通解；在 a 和 b 分别得到 0 与 −V₀。
text.en: Substitute both constants into the general solution; the boundary values are 0 at a and −V₀ at b.

prompt.zh: 求区域 $a\le r\le b$ 内的电位移场 $\vec D(\vec r)$。
prompt.en: Find the displacement field $\vec D(\vec r)$ in the region $a\le r\le b$.

text.zh: 先写原表的梯度关系与本构关系。
text.en: Begin with the crib gradient and constitutive relations.

text.zh: 电位只依赖 r，梯度只保留径向分量。
text.en: The potential depends only on r, so retain only the radial gradient component.

text.zh: 把上问的 V(r) 代入，保留外侧负号。
text.en: Substitute the preceding V(r), keeping the leading minus sign.

text.zh: 对 ln(r/a) 求导为 1/r，两个负号抵消。
text.en: The derivative of ln(r/a) is 1/r, and the two minus signs cancel.

text.zh: 最后乘以介电常数，得到 D；V₀>0 时方向由内导体指向外导体。
text.en: Multiply by permittivity to obtain D, pointing from the inner toward the outer conductor when V₀>0.

prompt.zh: 求内导体和外导体上的电荷密度。
prompt.en: Find the charge density on the inner and outer conductors.

text.zh: 从法向 D 的跳变条件开始。导体内部静电场为零，因此表面电荷由介质侧的法向 D 决定。
text.en: Start with the normal-D jump condition. The electrostatic field inside a conductor is zero, leaving the dielectric-side normal D.

text.zh: 内导体朝向介质的外法向为 +r̂；将上问的 D 取在 a⁺。
text.en: The inner conductor’s normal into the dielectric is +r̂. Evaluate the preceding D at a⁺.

text.zh: 外导体的内表面朝向介质的法向为 −r̂；取 b⁻ 后点积产生负号。
text.en: At the outer conductor’s inner surface the normal into the dielectric is −r̂. Evaluating at b⁻ therefore introduces a minus sign.

text.zh: 作为核对，两柱面的每单位长度电荷相加为零，而不是两处面密度数值相反。
text.en: Check that the charges per unit length cancel; the two surface densities themselves need not have equal magnitudes.

text.zh: 写出两个表面电荷密度，单位均为 C/m²。
text.en: State both surface charge densities, each in C/m².

prompt.zh: 求同轴电缆的单位长度电容。
prompt.en: Find the capacitance per unit length of the coaxial cable.

text.zh: 先写电容定义，并明确分母是两导体之间的电势差。
text.en: Begin with the capacitance definition, using the potential difference between conductors.

text.zh: 取任意长度 ℓ 的内导体，柱面面积为 2πaℓ，均匀面密度可移出积分。
text.en: Take an inner-conductor segment of arbitrary length ℓ. Its cylindrical area is 2πaℓ and the surface density is uniform.

text.zh: 代入上问的面密度，再除以长度，得到每单位长度电荷。
text.en: Substitute the surface density and divide by length to obtain charge per unit length.

text.zh: 对每单位长度使用同一电容定义，约去电压 V₀。
text.en: Use the same definition per unit length and cancel V₀.

text.zh: 所得量纲为 F/m。
text.en: The resulting dimension is F/m.

concept.zh: 本题考查柱对称 Laplace 方程，从电势边界条件一路求到表面电荷与电容。
concept.en: This problem solves a cylindrically symmetric Laplace equation, then obtains surface charge and capacitance from the potential.

known.zh: 同轴内、外导体半径为 $a$、$b$，有 $V(a)=0$、$V(b)=-V_0$；介质介电常数为 $\varepsilon$，间隙内没有自由体电荷。
known.en: The coaxial conductors have radii $a$ and $b$, with $V(a)=0$ and $V(b)=-V_0$. The gap has permittivity $\varepsilon$ and no free volume charge.

goal.zh: 求间隙内电势、电位移、两导体的表面电荷密度和单位长度电容。
goal.en: Find potential, electric displacement, both conductor surface-charge densities and capacitance per unit length.

approach.zh: 先用对称性把电势写成半径的函数，再用两个电势条件确定积分常数。由电势求场后，分别检查内、外导体表面法向的符号。
approach.en: Use symmetry to make potential a function of radius, then determine integration constants from both boundary potentials. Differentiate to obtain the field and check the outward normal separately at each conductor.

topic.zh: 库仑定律 · 矢量叠加

statement.zh:
两个半径为 $a$ 的导体球位于 x 轴上：一个位于 $x=-d$，总表面电荷为 $Q$；另一个位于 $x=d$，总表面电荷为 $-Q$。
下图给出了这一系统的示意图。
statement.en:
Two conducting spheres of radius $a$ are located on the x-axis: One sphere is located at $x=-d$ and has total surface charge $Q$, while the other sphere is located $x=d$ and has total surface charge $-Q$.
A diagram of this system is shown below.

figureCaption.zh: 复刻原卷插图，保留原图的视角、结构与标注。
figureCaption.en: Recreated from the exam figure, preserving its perspective, geometry and labels.

prompt.zh: 首先考虑位于原点、半径为 $a$、总表面电荷为 $Q$ 的导体球。求该球在 $r>a$（球外）产生的电场。
prompt.en: First, consider a conducting sphere of radius $a$ and total surface charge $Q$ located at the origin. Find the electric field due to this sphere for $r>a$ (outside the sphere).

text.zh: 先写高斯定律，取包围孤立导体球的同心球面，半径 R>a。
text.en: Begin with Gauss’s law on a concentric sphere of radius R>a enclosing the isolated conducting sphere.

text.zh: 由球对称性，代入径向电场、本构关系和面积元。
text.en: By spherical symmetry, substitute the radial field, constitutive relation and surface element.

text.zh: 点积为 1，两个角积分分别为 2π 和 2。
text.en: The unit-vector dot product is one and the angular integrals are 2π and 2.

text.zh: 两边除以球面积和介电常数，再把 R 改记为观察半径 r。
text.en: Divide by spherical area and permittivity, then relabel R as observation radius r.

prompt.zh: 求上图两个导体球在观察点 $P=(0,0,z)$ 产生的总电场。必须用笛卡尔坐标表示答案。
prompt.en: Find the total electric field due to both of the conducting spheres in the figure above at the observation point $P=(0,0,z)$. You must express your answer in terms of cartesian coordinates.

text.zh: 从库仑定律和叠加原理出发。按官方解采用各球等效为球心点电荷的近似。
text.en: Start with Coulomb’s law and superposition, using the official approximation that each sphere acts as a point charge at its center.

text.zh: 先写两个球心和观察点，再逐项相减得到从电荷到观察点的位移。
text.en: Write both centers and the observation point, then subtract each center from P.

text.zh: 两个距离相同。将正电荷 +Q 及其位移代入。
text.en: The distances agree. Substitute +Q and its displacement first.

text.zh: 负电荷必须连同自身符号代入；其 x 分量为正、z 分量与正电荷的相反。
text.en: Include the negative charge sign explicitly; its x component is positive and its z component opposes that of +Q.

text.zh: 逐分量相加：z 分量抵消，x 分量为两倍。
text.en: Add components: the z components cancel and the x components double.

text.zh: 化简为题目要求的笛卡尔坐标形式。
text.en: Simplify to the requested Cartesian vector form.

prompt.zh: 现在在观察点 $P$ 放置一个电荷量为 $-Q$ 的点电荷。两个导体球对该点电荷的作用力是多少？
prompt.en: A point charge with charge $-Q$ is now placed at observation point $P$. What is the force on the point charge due to the two conducting spheres?

text.zh: 先写点电荷受力公式，使用前一问中两个源电荷产生的外场。
text.en: Begin with the force on a point charge, using the external field from the two source charges.

text.zh: 题目放入的试探电荷是 −Q，不能只代入正的电荷大小。
text.en: The inserted test charge is −Q; retain its sign rather than using only its magnitude.

text.zh: 完整相乘，电荷因子变为 −Q²。按题目采用既定外场，不另计算试探电荷引起的球面电荷重分布。
text.en: Multiply explicitly to obtain −Q². Follow the specified external-field model without adding redistribution of the conducting-sphere charges.

text.zh: 力沿 −x 方向。
text.en: The force points along −x.

prompt.zh: 列出计算原点 $O=(0,0,0)$ 与观察点 $P=(0,0,z)$ 之间电势差的积分。不需要求解！
prompt.en: Set up an integral for calculating the potential difference between the origin $O=(0,0,0)$ and the observation point $P=(0,0,z)$. You do not need to solve it!

text.zh: 先写两端点电势差的线积分原式。
text.en: Begin with the line integral for the potential difference between the endpoints.

text.zh: 选择题目两点之间的 z 轴直线路径，用 ζ 作为积分变量，z 保留给终点。
text.en: Choose the straight z-axis path. Use ζ as the integration variable and reserve z for the endpoint.

text.zh: 把沿路径的电场代入；它始终只有 x 分量。题目只要求列式，到这里即可给出完整积分。
text.en: Substitute the field along the path, which has only an x component. This already provides the complete integral requested.

text.zh: 额外核对：x̂·ẑ=0，所以积分的被积函数处处为零。
text.en: As a check, x̂·ẑ=0, making the integrand zero everywhere.

prompt.zh: 静电学中，计算电势差时积分路径是否重要？静电学中的哪一个 Maxwell 方程说明了这一点？
prompt.en: In electrostatics, does the path of integration matter when calculating potential differences? Which of Maxwell’s equations for electrostatics tells us this?

text.zh: 先写静电场的 Maxwell–Faraday 方程：闭合路径上的环流为零。
text.en: Begin with the electrostatic Maxwell–Faraday equation: circulation around a closed path is zero.

text.zh: 取两条由同一起点 A 到同一终点 B 的路径 C₁、C₂，将第二条反向后闭合。
text.en: Take two paths C₁ and C₂ from the same A to the same B; reverse the second to form a closed loop.

steps.math: 0=\oint_{C_1-C_2}\mathbf E\cdot d\mathbf l=\int_{C_1}\mathbf E\cdot d\mathbf l-\int_{C_2}\mathbf E\cdot d\mathbf l

text.zh: 移项表明两条路径的积分相等，再乘电势定义中的负号。
text.en: Rearrange to show equal path integrals, then apply the minus sign in the potential definition.

steps.math: -\int_{C_1}\mathbf E\cdot d\mathbf l=-\int_{C_2}\mathbf E\cdot d\mathbf l=V(B)-V(A)

text.zh: 因此静电电势差只由端点决定；允许选择使点积最简单的路径。
text.en: The electrostatic potential difference therefore depends only on the endpoints; choose a path that simplifies the dot product.

answerText.zh: 不依赖路径，只依赖端点。
answerText.en: It depends only on the endpoints.

note.zh: 适用范围：两个真实导体球会相互极化，严格外场一般不等于球心点电荷叠加。这里沿用原卷模型；相距很远 a≪d 时可作近似。
note.en: Model limitation: real conducting spheres polarize one another, so their exact fields are not generally center-point-charge fields. This follows the exam model; it is a useful approximation when a≪d.

concept.zh: 本题考查电场的矢量叠加、受力以及静电势差的路径无关性。
concept.en: This problem combines vector field superposition, electric force and path independence of electrostatic potential.

known.zh: 两个半径为 $a$ 的导体球位于 $x=\pm d$，分别带 $+Q$、$-Q$；观察点为 $P=(0,0,z)$，另有关于原点至 $P$ 的电势差问题。
known.en: Two conducting spheres of radius $a$ are centered at $x=\pm d$ with charges $+Q$ and $-Q$. The observation point is $P=(0,0,z)$; the potential-difference question runs from the origin to $P$.

goal.zh: 从单球外部电场出发求两球的合场、试探电荷受力，并列出电势差积分，说明积分路径是否影响结果。
goal.en: Start with the exterior field of one sphere, find the combined field and force on a test charge, and set up the potential integral with an explanation of path independence.

approach.zh: 按试卷采用的球外场模型，先写出每个源指向观察点的位移矢量，再相加分量。电场是矢量，不能仅将两项大小相加；模型适用性见后面的核对说明。
approach.en: Under the exterior-sphere field model used by the exam, write each source-to-observer displacement vector before adding components. Add vectors rather than magnitudes; the later source note discusses the model's scope.

title.en: Resistance of a Microstrip Line at High Frequencies

topic.zh: 电流密度 · 电阻

statement.zh:
如课堂所述，由于趋肤效应，频率较高时电流倾向于靠近导体表面流动。考虑下方微带线，其性质如下：
• 宽度（y 方向）：$W$
• 高度（z 方向）：$h$
• 长度（x 方向）：无限长
• 电导率：$\sigma$

微带线中的电流密度分布给定为：
$$\vec J(z)=\begin{cases}J_0\hat x&\text{当 }0.4h\le z<0.5h\\0&\text{当 }-0.4h<z<0.4h\\J_0\hat x&\text{当 }-0.5h<z\le-0.4h\end{cases}$$
忽略由微带线有限宽度引起的电场边缘效应。
statement.en:
As discussed in class, due to the skin effect, current prefers to flow closer to the surfaces of a conductor at higher frequencies. Consider the microstrip line below, which has the following properties:
• Width (in y-dimension): $W$
• Height (in z-dimension): $h$
• Length (in x-dimension): infinite
• Conductivity: $\sigma$

The current density distribution in the microstrip line is given by:
$$\vec J(z)=\begin{cases}J_0\hat x&\text{for }0.4h\le z<0.5h\\0&\text{for }-0.4h<z<0.4h\\J_0\hat x&\text{for }-0.5h<z\le-0.4h\end{cases}$$
Ignore any electric field fringing effects due to the finite width of the microstrip line.

figureCaption.zh: 复刻原卷插图，保留原图的视角、结构与标注。
figureCaption.en: Recreated from the exam figure, preserving its perspective, geometry and labels.

label.zh: 趋肤效应与非均匀电流

prompt.zh: 计算流过微带线的总电流 $I$。
prompt.en: Calculate the total current $I$ flowing through the microstrip line.

text.zh: 先写公式表中的电流密度通量公式，总电流是穿过截面的 J 的法向分量积分。
text.en: Begin with the crib current-density flux equation: integrate the normal component of J over the cross-section.

text.zh: 电流沿 +x，所以选 yz 截面、外法向 +x̂；按原图 y 从 0 到 W，z 从 −0.5h 到 0.5h。
text.en: Current flows along +x, so choose a yz cross-section with normal +x̂. As drawn, y runs from 0 to W and z from −0.5h to 0.5h.

text.zh: 将分段电流密度逐段代入。中间层 J=0，只有上下两层贡献。
text.en: Substitute the piecewise current density. The middle has J=0, leaving the lower and upper layers.

text.zh: 先对 y 积分得到 W，再代入两段 z 的上下限。
text.en: Integrate over y to obtain W, then evaluate both z intervals.

text.zh: 每层厚度是 0.1h，总载流面积为 0.2Wh；电流量纲为 A。
text.en: Each layer is 0.1h thick, giving total conducting area 0.2Wh and current in amperes.

prompt.zh: 计算微带线单位长度电势降的大小 $V^{\prime}$。
prompt.en: Calculate the magnitude of the potential drop per unit length $V^{\prime}$ of the microstrip line.

text.zh: 先写电势差原式与微观欧姆定律。题目要求电压降的大小，符号约定应先明确。
text.en: Begin with the potential integral and microscopic Ohm’s law. Define the voltage-drop sign before taking its magnitude.

steps.math: V(B)-V(A)=-\int_A^B\mathbf E\cdot d\mathbf l,\qquad\mathbf J=\sigma\mathbf E

text.zh: 沿题设承载电流的表层取一条 x 方向路径；这一层的电场由 J₀/σ 给出。
text.en: Choose an x-directed path in a current-carrying surface layer. Its electric field follows from J₀/σ.

steps.math: \mathbf E=\frac{\mathbf J}{\sigma}=\frac{J_0}{\sigma}\hat{\mathbf x},\qquad d\mathbf l=\hat{\mathbf x}\,dx

text.zh: 在长度 ℓ 上代入积分并计算单位矢量点积。
text.en: Substitute into the integral over a length ℓ and evaluate the unit-vector dot product.

text.zh: 场强沿 x 不变，积分给出 ℓ。沿电流方向电位降低，因此电压降大小为正。
text.en: The field is independent of x, so integration gives ℓ. Potential decreases along the current, making the drop magnitude positive.

text.zh: 除以长度 ℓ，单位由 V 变为 V/m。
text.en: Divide by ℓ to obtain volts per meter.

prompt.zh: 计算微带线的单位长度电阻 $R^{\prime}$。
prompt.en: Calculate the resistance per unit length $R^{\prime}$ of the microstrip line.

text.zh: 先写电阻定义，再将其除以导线长度，得到单位长度形式。
text.en: Begin with the resistance definition and divide by conductor length to obtain its per-length form.

text.zh: 把 a)、b) 的两个结果完整代入，不要把电压降和总电压混淆。
text.en: Substitute both preceding results explicitly, distinguishing voltage drop per length from total voltage.

text.zh: 约去电流密度 J₀，将 1/0.2 化为 5。
text.en: Cancel J₀ and evaluate 1/0.2 as 5.

text.zh: 检查单位：(S/m)·m²= S·m，取倒数得到 Ω/m。
text.en: Check units: (S/m)·m² is S·m, whose reciprocal is Ω/m.

prompt.zh: 在电流密度与上文相同的情况下，用物理推理解释为什么增大电导率 $\sigma$ 会降低微带线的电阻。
prompt.en: For the same current density as above, use physical reasoning to explain why increasing the conductivity $\sigma$ would lead to a decrease in the resistance of the microstrip line.

text.zh: 先用微观欧姆定律明确哪些量固定：题目保持同一个 J(z) 分布和同一截面。
text.en: Use microscopic Ohm’s law to identify what stays fixed: the specified J(z) distribution and conductor cross-section.

steps.math: \mathbf J=\sigma\mathbf E,\qquad I=\iint\mathbf J\cdot d\mathbf S

text.zh: 固定电流密度与面积意味着总电流也不变。提高 σ 后，同一 J 所需的驱动电场更小。
text.en: Fixed current density and area keep total current unchanged. Increasing σ requires less driving field for that same J.

text.zh: 长度相同，电场减小会让单位长度电压降减小；把它代入电阻定义。
text.en: For the same length, a smaller field gives a smaller voltage drop per length. Substitute that into the resistance definition.

text.zh: 因此增加电导率会降低电阻；原因是维持相同电流所需的电压降减少。
text.en: Increasing conductivity therefore reduces resistance because the same current requires a smaller voltage drop.

answerText.zh: 更高电导率意味着维持同样电流只需更小的驱动电场。
answerText.en: Higher conductivity requires a smaller driving field for the same current.

prompt.zh: 在流过微带线的总电流相同的情况下，如果电流密度均匀分布在整个横截面上，而不是集中在表面附近，电阻会有什么不同？用物理推理简要解释。
prompt.en: For the same total current flowing through the microstrip line, how would the resistance of the microstrip line differ if the current density were distributed uniformly over the cross-section instead of being concentrated near the surfaces? Briefly explain using physical reasoning.

text.zh: 先写电流积分和欧姆定律。这次固定的是总电流 I，而不是原来的表层密度 J₀。
text.en: Begin with the current integral and Ohm’s law. Here total current I is fixed, rather than the previous surface-layer density J₀.

steps.math: I=\iint\mathbf J\cdot d\mathbf S,\qquad\mathbf E=\frac{\mathbf J}{\sigma}

text.zh: 均匀分布使用整个 Wh 截面；先求新的电流密度。
text.en: A uniform distribution uses the entire Wh cross-section. Compute the new current density first.

text.zh: 代入欧姆定律，电场与每单位长度电压降都变为原来的五分之一。
text.en: Substitute into Ohm’s law: both field and voltage drop per length become one fifth of their previous values.

text.zh: 总电流保持不变，将电压降比代入 R′=V′/I。
text.en: With total current unchanged, insert this voltage-drop ratio into R′=V′/I.

text.zh: 得到电阻减为五分之一，即下降 80%；物理原因是可供载流的有效面积扩大。
text.en: Resistance becomes one fifth, an 80% reduction, because the available current-carrying area increases.

concept.zh: 本题考查电流密度的通量积分、微观欧姆定律，以及趋肤效应为什么会增大电阻。
concept.en: This problem connects current-density flux, microscopic Ohm's law and the resistance increase caused by skin effect.

known.zh: 微带线宽为 $W$、厚为 $h$、电导率为 $\sigma$，电流沿 $x$ 方向。题设分段给出 $\vec J(z)$：上下表层有电流，中间区域为零。
known.en: The strip has width $W$, thickness $h$ and conductivity $\sigma$, with current along $x$. The given piecewise $\vec J(z)$ is nonzero in the top and bottom surface layers and zero in the middle.

goal.zh: 依次求总电流 $I$、单位长度电势降 $V^\prime$ 和单位长度电阻 $R^\prime$，再解释电导率与电流分布的影响。
goal.en: Find total current $I$, voltage drop per unit length $V^\prime$ and resistance per unit length $R^\prime$, then explain the effects of conductivity and current distribution.

approach.zh: 先认清哪些区域真正载流，再选垂直于电流的横截面积分。得到总电流后，用 $\mathbf J=\sigma\mathbf E$ 联系电场与电势降，最后回到电阻定义。
approach.en: Identify the current-carrying regions before integrating over a cross-section perpendicular to the current. Then use $\mathbf J=\sigma\mathbf E$ to connect field and voltage drop, and apply the definition of resistance.

topic.zh: 边界条件 · 极化

statement.zh:
下图是一组由三种电介质组成的叠层：
• 电介质 1：占据 $y>0.01\,\mathrm{m}$，介电常数为 $\varepsilon_1=2\varepsilon_0$
• 电介质 2：占据 $0<y<0.01\,\mathrm{m}$，介电常数为 $\varepsilon_2=5\varepsilon_0$
• 电介质 3：占据 $y<0$，介电常数为 $\varepsilon_3=2\varepsilon_0$

电介质 1 中的电场给定为：
$$\vec E_1=100\hat x-100\hat y$$
statement.en:
Shown below is a stack of three dielectric materials:
• Dielectric 1: occupies the region $y>0.01\,\mathrm{m}$ and has permittivity $\varepsilon_1=2\varepsilon_0$
• Dielectric 2: occupies the region $0<y<0.01\,\mathrm{m}$ and has permittivity $\varepsilon_2=5\varepsilon_0$
• Dielectric 3: occupies the region $y<0$ and has permittivity $\varepsilon_3=2\varepsilon_0$

The electric field in dielectric 1 is given by:
$$\vec E_1=100\hat x-100\hat y$$

figureCaption.zh: 复刻原卷插图，保留原图的视角、结构与标注。
figureCaption.en: Recreated from the exam figure, preserving its perspective, geometry and labels.

prompt.zh: 求电介质 2 中的电场 $\vec E_2$。
prompt.en: Find the electric field in dielectric 2, $\vec E_2$.

text.zh: 先写原表的两条静电边界条件和本构关系。
text.en: Begin with both crib electrostatic boundary conditions and the constitutive relation.

text.zh: 分界面是 y=0.01 m，法向沿 y、切向沿 x。先将已知电场分解。
text.en: The interface is y=0.01 m, with normal along y and tangent along x. Decompose the given field.

text.zh: 切向 E 连续，因此 x 分量直接传递，z 分量仍为零。
text.en: Tangential E is continuous, so the x component carries across and the z component remains zero.

text.zh: 无自由面电荷，令法向 D 的跳变为零，再解出 E₂y。
text.en: There is no free surface charge. Set the normal-D jump to zero and solve for E₂y.

text.zh: 代入两个介电常数，约去 ε₀，保留已知 y 分量的负号。
text.en: Insert both permittivities, cancel ε₀ and retain the negative y component.

text.zh: 把三个分量合成为矢量。
text.en: Combine all three components into the vector.

prompt.zh: 求电介质 3 中的电场 $\vec E_3$。
prompt.en: Find the electric field in dielectric 3, $\vec E_3$.

text.zh: 在 y=0 的第二个介质界面再次使用切向 E 连续和法向 D 连续。
text.en: At the second dielectric interface y=0, again use continuity of tangential E and normal D.

text.zh: 上问给出 E₂x=100、E₂y=−40，法向和切向仍分别为 y 与 x。
text.en: The preceding result gives E₂x=100 and E₂y=−40; y remains normal and x tangential.

text.zh: 先代入本构关系，再把 E₃y 单独移到一侧。
text.en: Substitute the constitutive relation and isolate E₃y.

text.zh: 代入 ε₂=5ε₀、ε₃=2ε₀ 和 −40 V/m。
text.en: Substitute ε₂=5ε₀, ε₃=2ε₀ and −40 V/m.

text.zh: 恢复完整矢量。因为 ε₃=ε₁，最终场与区域 1 一致。
text.en: Restore the complete vector. Since ε₃=ε₁, the field agrees with region 1.

prompt.zh: 计算电介质 2 两端的总电势差 $V_0$（即 $y=0.01\,\mathrm{m}$ 与 $y=0$ 之间）。
prompt.en: Calculate the total potential difference across dielectric 2, $V_0$, (i.e. between $y=0.01\,\mathrm{m}$ and $y=0$).

text.zh: 先明确电势差的次序，再写原表的负线积分。
text.en: Specify the order of the potential difference before writing the crib negative line integral.

text.zh: 选 x、z 不变的直线路径，仅有 dy 分量。
text.en: Choose a straight path at fixed x and z, leaving only a dy component.

steps.math: d\mathbf l=\hat{\mathbf y}\,dy,\qquad \mathbf E_2=(100\hat{\mathbf x}-40\hat{\mathbf y})\,\mathrm{V/m}

text.zh: 展开点积，x̂·ŷ=0，ŷ·ŷ=1，因此切向的 100 V/m 不参与本次电势差。
text.en: Expand the dot product: x̂·ŷ=0 and ŷ·ŷ=1, so the tangential 100 V/m does not contribute.

text.zh: 积分常数场，并把 0.01 m 代入上下限；外面的负号使结果为正。
text.en: Integrate the constant field and substitute the 0.01 m limits. The leading minus sign makes the result positive.

text.zh: 所求电势差为 +0.40 V，表示上表面的电位较高。
text.en: The requested difference is +0.40 V, meaning the upper surface is at higher potential.

prompt.zh: 利用电介质材料极化的概念，简要解释为什么电介质 2 中的电场大小与电介质 1 和电介质 3 中的电场大小不同。必须讨论相对大小：为什么其中一个比另外的更大或更小？
prompt.en: Using the concept of polarization in dielectric materials, briefly explain why the magnitude of the electric field in dielectric 2 is different from the magnitudes of the electric fields in dielectric 1 and dielectric 3. Be sure to comment on the relative magnitudes: why is one larger/smaller than the others?

text.zh: 用边界条件和 D=εE 作为解释起点；不是把全部电场都按 1/ε 缩放。
text.en: Start from the boundary conditions and D=εE. The entire field does not scale uniformly as 1/ε.

text.zh: 相同法向 D 下，介电常数最大的区域 2 具有最小的法向 E。
text.en: For the same normal D, region 2 has the smallest normal E because its permittivity is largest.

text.zh: 材料中的电偶极被极化，其响应使给定自由电荷产生的法向净场减弱；切向场仍由连续条件限定。
text.en: Polarization of material dipoles reduces the normal net field for the given free charge, while tangential continuity constrains the tangential field.

text.zh: 比较题目问到的总场大小，必须使用各分量平方和，而不是只比较 y 分量。
text.en: Compare total field magnitudes using the sum of squared components, rather than the y component alone.

text.zh: 因此区域 2 的总场较小，区域 1 和 3 的场强相同。
text.en: Region 2 therefore has the smaller total field, while regions 1 and 3 agree.

answerText.zh: 减小的是法向分量；不能把所有电场分量都按介电常数反比缩放。
answerText.en: The normal component decreases; do not scale every field component inversely with permittivity.

concept.zh: 本题考查分层介质中切向电场与法向电位移的边界条件，以及介质极化的解释。
concept.en: This problem applies tangential-field and normal-displacement boundary conditions to layered dielectrics and interprets them through polarization.

known.zh: 三层介电常数依次为 $2\varepsilon_0$、$5\varepsilon_0$、$2\varepsilon_0$，中间层厚 $0.01\,\mathrm m$；已给出第一层的 $\vec E_1=100\hat x-100\hat y$。
known.en: The layers have permittivities $2\varepsilon_0$, $5\varepsilon_0$ and $2\varepsilon_0$, with a $0.01\,\mathrm m$ middle layer. The first-layer field is $\vec E_1=100\hat x-100\hat y$.

goal.zh: 求第二、第三层电场和中间层两端的电势差，并用极化解释电场大小的差异。
goal.en: Find the fields in layers two and three and the voltage across the middle layer, then explain the field-magnitude differences through polarization.

approach.zh: 先按界面方向把电场分为切向与法向。在无自由面电荷的介质界面，分别使用切向电场连续和法向电位移连续，再沿法向路径计算电势差。
approach.en: Split the field into tangential and normal components. At a dielectric interface without free surface charge, preserve tangential electric field and normal displacement, then integrate along the normal to obtain the voltage.

topic.zh: 高斯定律 · 微分电容

statement.zh:
右侧同轴电缆的电介质质量较差，导致一些电荷泄漏到内导体与外导体之间。电缆的内导体半径为 $a$，面电荷密度为 $\rho_{sa}$；外导体壳的半径为 $b$，保持电势 $V(b)=0$。区域 $a<r<b$ 填充了介电常数为 $\varepsilon$ 的电介质，其体电荷密度给定为：
$$\rho(r)=\rho_0\frac{a}{r}$$
statement.en:
The coaxial cable to the right has a poor dielectric, which has allowed some charge to leak between the inner conductor and outer conductor. The cable has an inner conductor of radius $a$ with surface charge density $\rho_{sa}$ and an outer conducting shell of radius $b$, held at a potential $V(b)=0$. The region $a<r<b$ is filled with a dielectric of permittivity $\varepsilon$ and volumetric charge density given by:
$$\rho(r)=\rho_0\frac{a}{r}$$

figureCaption.zh: 复刻原卷插图，保留原图的视角、结构与标注。
figureCaption.en: Recreated from the exam figure, preserving its perspective, geometry and labels.

prompt.zh: 使用高斯定律，求区域 $a<r<b$ 内的电场 $\vec E(\vec r)$。附图说明所选高斯面的位置。
prompt.en: Using Gauss’s law, find the electric field $\vec E(\vec r)$ in the region $a<r<b$. Include a diagram that shows the location of your Gaussian surface.

text.zh: 先写原始高斯定律，再将电位移换成 εE。
text.en: Begin with the original Gauss equation and substitute εE for displacement.

text.zh: 选半径 R、长度 ℓ 的同轴闭合圆柱，高斯半径满足 a<R<b；端面的法向与径向电场垂直。
text.en: Choose a coaxial closed cylinder of radius R and length ℓ, with a<R<b. End-cap normals are perpendicular to the radial field.

steps.math: \mathbf E=E_r(R)\hat{\mathbf r},\quad d\mathbf S_{\mathrm{side}}=\hat{\mathbf r}R\,d\phi\,dz,\quad \mathbf E\cdot d\mathbf S_{\mathrm{caps}}=0

text.zh: 代入柱侧面通量积分，依次计算 φ 和 z 积分。
text.en: Substitute into the lateral-surface flux integral and evaluate the φ and z factors.

text.zh: 包围电荷分成内导体表面电荷与 a 到 R 之间的体电荷。先积分内导体柱面。
text.en: Split enclosed charge into the inner-conductor surface charge and volume charge from a to R. Integrate the inner surface first.

text.zh: 体电荷积分必须使用变半径 r′；将密度 ρ₀a/r′ 和柱坐标体积元 r′dr′dφdz 同时代入。
text.en: For volume charge use a varying radius r′. Substitute both ρ₀a/r′ and the cylindrical volume element r′dr′dφdz.

text.zh: 密度中的 1/r′ 与体积元的 r′ 抵消，剩下常数的径向积分。
text.en: The density’s 1/r′ cancels the volume element’s r′, leaving a constant radial integral.

text.zh: 把两项电荷相加后代入高斯定律，最后约去共同长度和 2π。
text.en: Add both charge terms, substitute into Gauss’s law and cancel the common length and 2π.

text.zh: 除以 εR，并把任意高斯半径 R 改记为观察半径 r。
text.en: Divide by εR and relabel the arbitrary Gaussian radius R as observation radius r.

figureCaption.zh: 保持同轴线三维视角，标出 a<R<b 的闭合高斯圆柱及长度 ℓ。
figureCaption.en: Coaxial geometry in its 3D perspective, showing a closed Gaussian cylinder with a<R<b and length ℓ.

prompt.zh: 求区域 $a<r<b$ 内的电势 $V(\vec r)$。
prompt.en: Find the potential $V(\vec r)$ in the region $a<r<b$.

text.zh: 先写电势差原式，参考点选题设接地的外导体。
text.en: Begin with the potential-difference integral, referenced to the grounded outer conductor.

text.zh: 选径向路径，积分变量用 s，避免和终点 r 混淆。
text.en: Use a radial path and integration variable s, distinct from endpoint r.

text.zh: 将括号展开成 1/s 项和常数项，再把积分上下限反转去掉外侧负号。
text.en: Expand into a 1/s term and a constant, then reverse the limits to remove the leading minus sign.

text.zh: 分别积分：第一项产生对数，第二项产生线性距离。
text.en: Integrate separately: the first term gives a logarithm and the second a linear distance.

text.zh: 代入两端，使用 ln b−ln r=ln(b/r)。在 r=b 时对数项和线性项都为零。
text.en: Evaluate both endpoints and use ln b−ln r=ln(b/r). Both terms vanish at r=b.

prompt.zh: 求导体之间的电势差 $V_0=V(a)-V(b)$。然后将内导体的面电荷密度 $\rho_{sa}$ 表示为 $V_0$ 和 $\rho_0$ 的函数。
prompt.en: Find the potential difference between the conductors, $V_0=V(a)-V(b)$. Then, express the surface charge density on the inner conductor, $\rho_{sa}$, as a function of $V_0$ and $\rho_0$.

text.zh: 先按定义写两导体电势差，再把上一问电位函数取在 a 和 b。
text.en: Begin with the conductor potential difference and evaluate the preceding potential at a and b.

text.zh: 将 r=a 代入，保留完整的对数项与线性项。
text.en: Substitute r=a, retaining both logarithmic and linear contributions.

text.zh: 两边乘 ε/a，先消去最外层的系数。
text.en: Multiply both sides by ε/a to remove the outer coefficient.

text.zh: 把与 ρsa 无关的线性项移到左边，再除以 ln(b/a)。
text.en: Move the linear term independent of ρsa to the left and divide by ln(b/a).

text.zh: 最后加回 aρ₀，并把分子展开；每一项的量纲都是 C/m²。
text.en: Add back aρ₀ and expand the numerator. Every term has dimension C/m².

prompt.zh: 当两导体之间存在体电荷密度时，不能用通常的公式计算电容，而必须定义为 $C=\frac{dQ}{dV_0}$，其中 $Q$ 为其中一个导体的总电荷，$V_0$ 为导体间的电势差。使用这一定义和前几问的结果，求电缆的单位长度电容 $C^{\prime}$。
prompt.en: When a volumetric charge density exists in the region between two conductors, the capacitance cannot be computed using the usual formulas. Instead, it must be defined by $C=\frac{dQ}{dV_0}$, where $Q$ is the total charge on one conductor and $V_0$ is the potential difference between the conductors. Using this definition and your results from earlier parts, determine the capacitance per unit length $C^{\prime}$ of the cable.

text.zh: 本题明确要求微分电容：背景空间电荷保持不变，只改变两导体间电势差。
text.en: Use the differential capacitance required by the question: hold the background space charge fixed while varying the conductor voltage.

text.zh: 先用内导体表面电荷密度求每单位长度电荷。
text.en: First convert the inner-conductor surface density to charge per unit length.

text.zh: 把 c) 求出的 ρsa 完整代入。
text.en: Substitute the full expression for ρsa from part c).

text.zh: 把含 V₀ 的线性项与固定电荷造成的偏移量分开。
text.en: Separate the term linear in V₀ from the fixed-charge offset.

text.zh: 对 V₀ 求导。第一项留下系数，第二项在固定 ρ₀ 时导数为零。
text.en: Differentiate with respect to V₀. The first term leaves its coefficient and the fixed-ρ₀ offset has zero derivative.

text.zh: 所以空间电荷改变 Q–V 曲线截距，却不改变这里的斜率。
text.en: Space charge changes the Q–V intercept but not the slope in this model.

concept.zh: 本题考查有体电荷时的柱对称高斯定律、电势积分和微分电容，不能直接套用无体电荷的同轴公式。
concept.en: This problem combines cylindrical Gauss's law, potential integration and differential capacitance in the presence of volume charge.

known.zh: 内、外导体半径为 $a$、$b$，内表面电荷密度为 $\rho_{sa}$，外导体接地；间隙介电常数为 $\varepsilon$，体电荷密度为 $\rho(r)=\rho_0a/r$。
known.en: The conductors have radii $a$ and $b$, inner surface-charge density $\rho_{sa}$ and a grounded outer conductor. The gap has permittivity $\varepsilon$ and volume-charge density $\rho(r)=\rho_0a/r$.

goal.zh: 求电场、电势和导体间电压，再将 $\rho_{sa}$ 写成电压的函数，最后用 $dQ/dV_0$ 求单位长度电容。
goal.en: Find field, potential and conductor voltage, express $\rho_{sa}$ as a function of voltage, then obtain capacitance per unit length using $dQ/dV_0$.

approach.zh: 同轴高斯面包围的电荷包括内导体表面电荷和一部分体电荷。先分别计入二者，再积分得到电势；求微分电容时保持给定体电荷分布不变。
approach.en: A coaxial Gaussian surface encloses both inner-conductor charge and part of the volume charge. Account for both before integrating the field to potential; hold the given volume-charge distribution fixed when differentiating for capacitance.

title.zh: 导体平面上方的点电荷
title.en: Point Charges over a Conducting Plane

topic.zh: 镜像法 · 面电荷

statement.zh: 两个固定不动的点电荷保持在理想导体平面上方高度 $z_0$ 处，导体占据区域 $z<0$。点电荷 $-q$ 位于 $(-x_0,0,z_0)$，点电荷 $+q$ 位于 $(x_0,0,z_0)$。导体上方区域 $(z>0)$ 的介电常数为 $\varepsilon_0$。
statement.en: Two immobile point charges are held at a height $z_0$ above a perfectly conducting plane that occupies the region $z<0$. A point charge $-q$ is located at $(-x_0,0,z_0)$ and a charge $+q$ is located at $(x_0,0,z_0)$. The region above the conductor $(z>0)$ has permittivity $\varepsilon_0$.

figureCaption.zh: 复刻原卷插图，保留原图的视角、结构与标注。
figureCaption.en: Recreated from the exam figure, preserving its perspective, geometry and labels.

prompt.zh: 在 x-z 平面内画出用于镜像法的几何示意图。包括真实电荷、镜像电荷及其坐标，并清楚标出导体表面的位置。
prompt.en: Draw a diagram in the x-z plane showing the geometry you will use for applying the method of images. Include the real charges, their image charges, their coordinates, and clearly mark the position of the conducting surface.

text.zh: 镜像构造要满足导体边界：表面为等势面，导体内部静电场为零。
text.en: The image construction must satisfy an equipotential conducting surface and zero electrostatic field inside the conductor.

text.zh: 在 x–z 平面先画 z=0，再标出两个真实电荷及其坐标；二者的 y 坐标均为零。
text.en: Draw z=0 in the x–z plane, then place both real charges with coordinates; both have y=0.

text.zh: 对左边的 −q，位置关于 z=0 反射，符号反转，得到位于下方的 +q。
text.en: Reflect the left −q across z=0 and reverse its sign, obtaining +q below the plane.

text.zh: 对右边的 +q 作相同操作，得到下方的 −q；上下高度均应标为 z₀。
text.en: Do the same for the right +q, obtaining −q below the plane. Mark equal heights z₀ above and below.

text.zh: 核对边界：平面上每一对真实电荷与镜像到观察点距离相等、电荷符号相反，电位逐对抵消。
text.en: Check the boundary: each real charge and its image are equidistant from a point on the plane and have opposite signs, so their potentials cancel pairwise.

text.zh: 这四个点构成用于求上半空间场的数学系统，下面的镜像电荷不是导体中的真实点电荷。
text.en: These four points define the mathematical system for the upper-half-space field; the images are not physical point charges inside the conductor.

answerText.zh: 镜像只用于求 z>0 的真实场；z<0 是数学延拓区域。
answerText.en: Images reproduce the physical field only for z>0; z<0 is a mathematical extension.

figureCaption.zh: x–z 平面的四电荷镜像构造，标出真实和镜像电荷坐标及导体表面 z=0。
figureCaption.en: Four-charge image construction in the x–z plane, with real/image coordinates and conducting surface z=0.

prompt.zh: 另画一张图，画出第 a) 问中各电荷之间的电场线，包括 $z<0$ 区域中的电场线。
prompt.en: In a new diagram, sketch the electric field lines between the charges you drew in part a), including those in the region $z<0$.

text.zh: 先写四点电荷的库仑场叠加式，场线切线方向必须与该合场一致。
text.en: Begin with the Coulomb superposition of all four charges; field-line tangents must follow that total field.

text.zh: 逐一代入 a) 的位置和符号：右上、左下为正，左上、右下为负。
text.en: Substitute the positions and signs from a): upper right and lower left are positive; upper left and lower right are negative.

text.zh: 在平面上，真实电荷与对应镜像的切向场抵消、法向场相加，所以场线必须垂直穿过 z=0。
text.en: On the plane, each real–image pair cancels tangential field and adds normal field, so field lines meet z=0 normally.

text.zh: 箭头从正电荷出发、到负电荷结束；图中上方主要由右向左，下方主要由左向右，符合四电荷的符号。
text.en: Arrows leave positive charges and end on negative charges: mainly right to left above and left to right below, consistent with all four signs.

text.zh: 图中场线形状为对称几何示意，弯曲程度随 x₀/z₀ 改变。下半空间只表示镜像系统，真实导体内部 E=0。
text.en: The lines illustrate the symmetric geometry; their curvature depends on x₀/z₀. Below the plane they show the image system only; the physical conductor has E=0.

answerText.zh: 图中箭头给出方向，导体内部真实电场为零。
answerText.en: Arrows show direction; the physical field inside the conductor is zero.

figureCaption.zh: 场线以 x₀=z₀ 作几何示意，从正电荷到负电荷；下半空间仅为数学镜像系统，实际导体内部电场为零。
figureCaption.en: Illustrative field lines with x₀=z₀, from positive to negative charges; the lower half is only the image system, and the physical conductor field is zero.

prompt.zh: 忽略导体平面，求仅由位于 $(x_0,0,z_0)$ 的点电荷 $+q$ 在点 $P=(x,0,0)$ 产生的电场 $\vec E_{+q}$。
prompt.en: Determine the electric field $\vec E_{+q}$ at a point $P=(x,0,0)$ solely due to the point charge $+q$ located at $(x_0,0,z_0)$, ignoring the conducting plane.

text.zh: 先写原表的点电荷电场。将单位径向矢量换成位移除以距离，就得到适合坐标代入的形式。
text.en: Begin with the crib point-charge field. Replace the radial unit vector by displacement divided by distance for coordinate substitution.

text.zh: 源电荷位于 (x₀,0,z₀)，观察点为 (x,0,0)；位移必须是观察点减源点。
text.en: The source is at (x₀,0,z₀) and observation point at (x,0,0). Displacement is observation minus source.

text.zh: 逐分量求距离和单位矢量，注意 z 分量为负。
text.en: Compute the distance and unit vector component by component, keeping the negative z component.

text.zh: 将 q、位移和距离完整代入库仑定律。此问明确忽略导体，因此不加入镜像。
text.en: Substitute the charge, displacement and distance into Coulomb’s law. This part explicitly ignores the conductor, so include no image charges.

prompt.zh: 考虑两个真实电荷及导体平面的影响，求导体表面点 $P=(x,0,0)$ 处的总电场 $\vec E_{tot}$。
prompt.en: Determine the total electric field $\vec E_{tot}$ at the point $P=(x,0,0)$ on the surface of the conductor, taking into account both real charges and the effect of the conducting plane.

text.zh: 总场由两个真实电荷和两个镜像电荷相加得到，不能只把 c) 的单个电场乘二。
text.en: The total field sums both real charges and both images; doubling the single field in c) is insufficient.

text.zh: 用 R_L、R_R 分别表示观察点到左、右电荷列的距离；每列上下电荷到平面的距离相同。
text.en: Use R_L and R_R for distances from P to the left and right charge columns. Within a column, real and image distances to P agree.

text.zh: 先展开右列：真实 +q 和镜像 −q 的 x 分量相消，z 分量相加为 −2qz₀。
text.en: Expand the right column first: real +q and image −q cancel in x and add to −2qz₀ in z.

text.zh: 再展开左列：真实 −q 和镜像 +q 的切向分量相消，法向分量给出相反的正号。
text.en: Expand the left column next: real −q and image +q cancel tangentially and give the opposite, positive normal sign.

text.zh: 相加并提取公因子；这也显式验证了导体表面的切向场为零。
text.en: Add and factor the common coefficient, explicitly verifying zero tangential field at the conductor.

prompt.zh: 使用第 d) 问的结果，计算导体上点 $P=(x,0,0)$ 处的面电荷密度 $\rho_s(\vec r)$。
prompt.en: Using your result from part d), calculate the surface charge density $\rho_s(\vec r)$ on the conductor at the point $P=(x,0,0)$.

text.zh: 先写原表的法向位移跳变条件，法向取从导体指向空气的 +ẑ。
text.en: Begin with the crib normal-displacement jump condition, using +ẑ from conductor into air.

text.zh: 导体内部 D=0，外部为 ε₀E；因此表面电荷等于外侧电场的有符号法向分量乘 ε₀。
text.en: Inside the conductor D=0 and outside D=ε₀E, so surface charge is ε₀ times the signed exterior normal field.

text.zh: 完整代入 d) 的电场，先保留 ε₀ 因子再约去。
text.en: Substitute the full field from d), retaining ε₀ before cancellation.

text.zh: 用位置坐标展开距离；在 x=0 两项相等，右侧 x>0 对应负的感应电荷，可作符号核对。
text.en: Expand the distances in coordinates. At x=0 the terms cancel; for x>0 the induced charge is negative, providing a sign check.

concept.zh: 本题考查镜像法、库仑场叠加和理想导体表面的电荷边界条件。
concept.en: This problem combines image charges, Coulomb-field superposition and the surface-charge boundary condition at a perfect conductor.

known.zh: 真实电荷 $-q$、$+q$ 位于 $(-x_0,0,z_0)$、$(x_0,0,z_0)$；理想导体占据 $z<0$，上方介质的介电常数为 $\varepsilon_0$，观察点在表面上方。
known.en: The real charges $-q$ and $+q$ are at $(-x_0,0,z_0)$ and $(x_0,0,z_0)$. A perfect conductor occupies $z<0$, the upper region has permittivity $\varepsilon_0$, and the field is evaluated just above its surface.

goal.zh: 构造镜像几何与电场线，求单个真实电荷和完整系统的表面电场，再求感应面电荷密度。
goal.en: Construct the image geometry and field lines, find the surface field of one real charge and of the complete system, then obtain induced surface-charge density.

approach.zh: 先为每个真实电荷确定镜像的位置和符号，再逐项写出位移矢量。叠加后检查导体表面的切向场是否抵消；镜像下半空间用于辅助计算，不是导体内部的真实电场。
approach.en: Assign each real charge its mirrored position and opposite sign, then write the displacement vectors. Check cancellation of tangential field at the conductor; the image region is a mathematical construction, not the physical field inside the conductor.
